literature.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期乙型肝炎病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 喀麦隆 HBV 总体 患病率 为 9.98%(95% 置信区间 [CI] 9.00-11.02),异质性较高 (I 2 = 98.10%)。相对较低风险和较高风险人群的 患病率 分别为 8.94% (95% CI 7.84-10.11) 和 12.70% (95% CI 10.28-15.32)。总体而言,喀麦隆的 HBV 患病率 仍然很高。 [10.1111/jvh.70219]
在 199,143 名接受治疗的患者中(中位随访时间为 7.3 年),15,233 名患者发展为 HCC。调整后的年度 HCC 发病率 在不同风险层中逐渐增加:低风险组为 0.31% (95% CI 0.24–0.40),中风险组为 1.09% (0.84–1.41),高风险组为 1.85% (1.44–2.40)。 [10.17998/jlc.2026.08.23]
使用探针捕获方法从病毒载量 > 1000 IU/mL、使用 PCR-Illumina 方法 > 200 IU/mL 和使用 PCR-Nanopore 方法 > 10 IU/mL 的样本中成功获得完整 HBV 基因组。宏基因组方法未能在任何样本中检测到 HBV。 [10.1002/jmv.71130]
初选系列结束后一个月,所有三组的血清保护率都很高且相似。与 3 剂量组相比,2 剂量组的 GMT 较低。攻击剂量后,所有组的记忆反应相似,异源 2 剂量组显示的 GMT 在数值上高于 3 剂量组。 [10.1093/infdis/jiag122]
报告的最常见 治疗 相关新发不良事件为注射部位反应。单次剂量的 ALG-020572 在健康受试者中显示出良好的药代动力学和安全性特征。然而,在4名受试者因药物诱导性肝损伤出现显著丙氨酸氨基转移酶升高后,研究被提前终止。 [10.1111/jvh.70224]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Overall prevalence of HBV in Cameroon was 9.98% (95% confidence interval [CI] 9.00-11.02) with high heterogeneity (I 2 = 98.10%). The prevalences for relatively lower-risk and higher-risk populations were 8.94% (95% CI 7.84-10.11) and 12.70% (95% CI 10.28-15.32), respectively. [10.1111/jvh.70219]

Among 199,143 treated patients (median follow-up, 7.3 years), 15,233 developed HCC. Adjusted annual HCC incidence increased progressively across risk strata: 0.31% (95% CI 0.24–0.40) in the low-risk group, 1.09% (0.84–1.41) in the intermediate-risk group, and 1.85% (1.44–2.40) in the high-risk group. [10.17998/jlc.2026.08.23]

Full HBV genomes were successfully obtained from samples with viral loads > 1000 IU/mL using probe-capture methods, > 200 IU/mL using PCR-Illumina methods, and > 10 IU/mL using PCR-Nanopore methods. Metagenomic methods failed to detect HBV in any samples. [10.1002/jmv.71130]
One month after the primary series, seroprotection rates were high and similar across all three groups. GMTs were lower in the 2-dose groups compared to the 3-dose group. [10.1093/infdis/jiag122]

The most common treatment-emergent adverse event reported was injection site reaction. Single doses of ALG-020572 demonstrated a favourable pharmacokinetic and safety profile in healthy participants. [10.1111/jvh.70224]

news.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期乙型肝炎病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 一项回顾性 队列研究 研究发现,戒烟与 慢性乙型肝炎 患者患肝细胞癌的风险降低 22% 相关,但并未建立因果关系。该研究还指出,改用电子烟也显示出类似的风险降低,但戒烟的一致性较差。 [news-edc7d9e8d48dde39]
在埃塞俄比亚进行的一项研究表明,干血斑可以可靠地定量 HBV DNA 并检测 HBeAg,这是 乙型肝炎病毒 感染的两个关键标志物。Bioengineer.org 于 2026 年 9 月 3 日报道了该研究。该事件根据该研究结果得到证实。 [news-cdb914fe0b9c54a7]
GSK 获得全球首个监管部门批准 Hibsago(bepirovirsen)作为治疗 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒感染的 功能性治愈。此次批准基于 III 期试验数据,该数据显示 功能性治愈 患者中 功能性治愈 的发生率显着。 [news-cddbb1ea2ac4c080]
《美国管理护理杂志》发表了一篇题为“如何推进乙型肝炎消除”的评论,作者为公共卫生硕士 Helen Nde。这篇文章是指导性讨论,而不是已确认的 暴发 或调查的报告。 [news-000c96dc6572e5c1]
肝移植外科医生Vibha Varma就乙型肝炎进行科普解读,阐述其在肝硬化发生前与肝癌的关联,并强调新生儿疫苗接种及母婴传播的预防。此内容为医疗科普指导,而非确诊暴发。 [news-d2e13778100c35a3]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Hepatitis B virus news developments.
key_findings_en: A retrospective cohort study found that quitting smoking was associated with a 22% lower risk of hepatocellular carcinoma in patients with chronic hepatitis B, though it did not establish a causal relationship. [news-edc7d9e8d48dde39]

A study conducted in Ethiopia demonstrated that dried blood spots can reliably quantify HBV DNA and detect HBeAg, two key markers for hepatitis B virus infection. The study was reported by Bioengineer.org on September 3, 2026. The event is confirmed based on the study's findings. [news-cdb914fe0b9c54a7]

GSK received the world's first regulatory approval for Hibsago (bepirovirsen) as a functional cure for chronic hepatitis B virus infection. This approval is based on Phase III trial data showing significant functional cure rates in patients with chronic hepatitis B. [news-cddbb1ea2ac4c080]

The American Journal of Managed Care published a commentary titled “What It Will Take to Advance Hepatitis B Elimination” authored by Helen Nde, MPH. The piece is a guidance‐type discussion rather than a report of a confirmed outbreak or investigation. [news-000c96dc6572e5c1]

Vibha Varma, a liver transplant surgeon, provides an explanatory guidance on hepatitis B, discussing its link to liver cancer before cirrhosis and emphasizing newborn vaccination and prevention of mother‐to‐child transmission. This is presented as medical guidance, not a confirmed outbreak. [news-d2e13778100c35a3]

A retrospective cohort study found that quitting smoking was associated with a 22% lower risk of hepatocellular carcinoma in patients with chronic hepatitis B, though it did not establish a causal relationship.
A study conducted in Ethiopia demonstrated that dried blood spots can reliably quantify HBV DNA and detect HBeAg, two key markers for hepatitis B virus infection.
GSK received the world's first regulatory approval for Hibsago (bepirovirsen) as a functional cure for chronic hepatitis B virus infection.
The American Journal of Managed Care published a commentary titled “What It Will Take to Advance Hepatitis B Elimination” authored by Helen Nde, MPH.

papers.title: Immunogenicity of Two Versus Three Doses of Hepatitis B Vaccine When Administered to Children Aged 2-18 Months: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: A 2-dose hepatitis B vaccination schedule is highly immunogenic in children aged ≥1 year, but data for infants are scarce. Our goal was to compare the immunogenicity of 2- and 3-dose hepatitis B vaccination schedules in this population. METHODS: Children in the experimental group were recruited at 2 months of age and randomized to receive a homologous (Infanrix-hexa/Infanrix-hexa) or heterologous (Infanrix-hexa/Twinrix) 2-dose schedule at 2 and 12 months. Children in the control group were recruited at 18 months and had received a homologous 3-dose schedule (Infanrix-hexa/Infanrix-hexa/Infanrix-hexa) at 2, 4, and 18 months. All groups received a challenge dose (Twinrix) 3 years later. RESULTS: One month after the primary series, seroprotection rates (anti-HBs ≥10 mIU/mL) were high and similar among the 3 groups (heterologous 2-dose, 91.7%; homologous 2-dose, 90.9%; 3-dose, 94.2%). Geometric mean titers (GMTs) were lower in the 2-dose groups than in the 3-dose group. Post-challenge dose, the majority exhibited an anamnestic response, similar across all 3 groups (heterologous 2-dose, 97.2%; homologous 2-dose, 95.5%; 3-dose, 92.7%). GMTs were numerically higher in the heterologous 2-dose group (9380.5 mIU/mL) than in the 3-dose group (6900.6 mIU/mL) (P = .4). The proportion exhibiting local reactions was significantly lower after the heterologous 2-dose schedule than after the homologous 2-dose schedule. CONCLUSIONS: The anamnestic response 3 years after 2-dose (2 and 12 months) and 3-dose (2, 4, and 18 months) hepatitis B vaccination schedules was similar. The heterologous 2-dose schedule was more immunogenic and less reactogenic than the homologous 2-dose schedule.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to compare the immunogenicity of 2- and 3-dose hepatitis B vaccination schedules in children aged 2-18 months, as data on infants are limited despite the high immunogenicity of 2-dose schedules in older children.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A randomized clinical trial was conducted comparing two 2-dose schedules (homologous and heterologous) with a 3-dose schedule, involving children recruited at different ages and receiving vaccines at specified intervals.
analysis.methods: Children were randomized to receive either a homologous or heterologous 2-dose schedule at 2 and 12 months, or a homologous 3-dose schedule at 2, 4, and 18 months. All groups received a challenge dose (Twinrix) 3 years later.
analysis.main_results: One month after the primary series, seroprotection rates were high and similar across all three groups. GMTs were lower in the 2-dose groups compared to the 3-dose group. Post-challenge dose, anamnestic responses were similar across all groups, with the heterologous 2-dose group showing numerically higher GMTs than the 3-dose group.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that the anamnestic response was similar between 2-dose and 3-dose schedules, but the heterologous 2-dose schedule was more immunogenic and less reactogenic than the homologous 2-dose schedule.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that a 2-dose vaccination schedule may be as effective as a 3-dose schedule in children aged 2-18 months, potentially informing vaccination strategies for infants.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's design and results are limited by the lack of long-term follow-up and the potential for confounding factors, but the evidence is strong due to the randomized clinical trial setup and direct comparisons of immunogenicity and reactogenicity.

analysis.summary_en: This randomized clinical trial compared the immunogenicity of 2- and 3-dose hepatitis B vaccination schedules in children aged 2-18 months. The study found that seroprotection rates were high and similar across all three groups one month after the primary series. Geometric mean titers (GMTs) were lower in the 2-dose groups than in the 3-dose group. Post-challenge dose, anamnestic responses were similar across all groups, with the heterologous 2-dose group showing numerically higher GMTs than the 3-dose group. The authors concluded that the anamnestic response was similar between 2-dose and 3-dose schedules, but the heterologous 2-dose schedule was more immunogenic and less reactogenic than the homologous 2-dose schedule. The study's findings suggest that a 2-dose schedule may be as effective as a 3-dose schedule in infants, potentially influencing vaccination strategies. However, the study's limitations include the lack of long-term follow-up and potential confounding factors, though the evidence is strong due to the randomized trial design.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在比较 2-18 个月儿童中 2 剂和 3 剂乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 方案的免疫原性,因为尽管 2 剂方案对年龄较大的儿童具有高免疫原性,但婴儿数据有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 进行了一项随机临床试验,将两种 2 剂量方案(同源和异源)与 3 剂量方案进行比较,该试验涉及在不同年龄招募并按指定时间间隔接受 疫苗 的儿童。
elements_zh.methods: 儿童在 2 个月和 12 个月时被随机分配接受同源或异源 2 剂方案,或在 2、4 和 18 个月时接受同源 3 剂方案。3 年后,所有组均接受攻击剂量 (Twinrix)。
elements_zh.main_results: 初选系列结束后一个月,所有三组的血清保护率都很高且相似。与 3 剂量组相比,2 剂量组的 GMT 较低。攻击剂量后,所有组的记忆反应相似,异源 2 剂量组显示的 GMT 在数值上高于 3 剂量组。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出结论,2 剂量和 3 剂量方案之间的记忆反应相似,但异源 2 剂量方案比同源 2 剂量方案具有更高的免疫原性和更低的反应原性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,对于 2-18 个月的儿童,2 剂 疫苗接种 方案可能与 3 剂方案一样有效,这可能为婴儿的 疫苗接种 策略提供参考。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的设计和结果因缺乏长期随访和可能存在混杂因素而受到限制,但由于随机临床试验的设置以及免疫原性和反应原性的直接比较,证据是强有力的。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:2剂乙型肝炎疫苗疫苗接种方案在≥1岁儿童中高度免疫原性,但婴儿期数据缺乏。本研究旨在比较2剂与3剂乙型肝炎疫苗疫苗接种方案在该人群中的免疫原性。方法:实验组儿童于2月龄时招募,随机分配接受同源(Infanrix-hexa/Infanrix-hexa)或异源(Infanrix-hexa/Twinrix)2剂方案,于2月龄和12月龄接种。对照组儿童于18月龄时招募,已接受同源3剂方案(Infanrix-hexa/Infanrix-hexa/Infanrix-hexa),于2月龄、4月龄和18月龄接种。所有组别均于3年后接种加强剂量(Twinrix)。结果:主要免疫程序完成后1个月,3组血清保护率(抗-HBs ≥10 mIU/mL)均较高且相似(异源2剂组91.7%,同源2剂组90.9%,3剂组94.2%)。几何平均滴度(GMT)在2剂组低于3剂组。加强剂量后,大多数受试者均表现出回忆应答,且3组间相似(异源2剂组97.2%,同源2剂组95.5%,3剂组92.7%)。GMT在异源2剂组(9380.5 mIU/mL)数值上高于3剂组(6900.6 mIU/mL)(P = .4)。异源2剂方案的局部反应发生率显著低于同源2剂方案。结论:2剂(2月龄和12月龄)与3剂(2月龄、4月龄和18月龄)乙型肝炎疫苗疫苗接种方案完成3年后的回忆应答相似。异源2剂方案较同源2剂方案更具免疫原性且反应原性更低。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在比较 2-18 个月儿童中 2 剂和 3 剂乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 方案的免疫原性,因为尽管 2 剂方案对年龄较大的儿童具有高免疫原性,但婴儿数据有限。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 进行了一项随机临床试验,将两种 2 剂量方案(同源和异源)与 3 剂量方案进行比较,该试验涉及在不同年龄招募并按指定时间间隔接受 疫苗 的儿童。
analysis_zh.methods: 儿童在 2 个月和 12 个月时被随机分配接受同源或异源 2 剂方案,或在 2、4 和 18 个月时接受同源 3 剂方案。3 年后,所有组均接受攻击剂量 (Twinrix)。
analysis_zh.main_results: 初选系列结束后一个月,所有三组的血清保护率都很高且相似。与 3 剂量组相比,2 剂量组的 GMT 较低。攻击剂量后,所有组的记忆反应相似,异源 2 剂量组显示的 GMT 在数值上高于 3 剂量组。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出结论,2 剂量和 3 剂量方案之间的记忆反应相似,但异源 2 剂量方案比同源 2 剂量方案具有更高的免疫原性和更低的反应原性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,对于 2-18 个月的儿童,2 剂 疫苗接种 方案可能与 3 剂方案一样有效,这可能为婴儿的 疫苗接种 策略提供参考。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的设计和结果因缺乏长期随访和可能存在混杂因素而受到限制,但由于随机临床试验的设置以及免疫原性和反应原性的直接比较,证据是强有力的。

papers.title: Prevalence of Hepatitis B Virus Infection in Cameroon: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
papers.abstract: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a global public health problem, and many regions of Sub-Saharan Africa are disproportionately affected, including Cameroon, where prevalence has previously been shown to be high. This study aimed to provide up-to-date estimates of HBV prevalence in Cameroon. We searched Medline, Global Health, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Africa Index Medicus and the Journal of Health Science and Disease at the University of Yaounde. We included studies reporting HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) prevalence in the general population and subpopulations. A random-effects meta-analysis was used to generate pooled estimates of HBsAg prevalence, overall and for population subgroups including those considered at relatively higher-risk and relatively lower-risk of HBV infection. Heterogeneity was assessed using the index of heterogeneity (I 2 ). Quality was assessed using the Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tool. Out of 1236 records, 92 papers with 100 studies were included in the meta-analysis. Overall prevalence of HBV in Cameroon was 9.98% (95% confidence interval [CI] 9.00-11.02) with high heterogeneity (I 2 = 98.10%). The prevalences for relatively lower-risk and higher-risk populations were8.94% (95% CI 7.84-10.11) and 12.70% (95% CI 10.28-15.32), respectively. In subgroup analyses, we found that sex, geographical area (regions), population risk groups and study design were the main sources of heterogeneity. Overall, HBV prevalence remains high in Cameroon. Our findings suggest an urgent need for health interventions to halt the spread of the disease, with particular attention needed for males and regions with the highest prevalence.

analysis.scope_and_question: This study aimed to provide up-to-date estimates of HBV prevalence in Cameroon. The review focused on human hepatitis B virus infection, genotypes and disease, with an emphasis on prevalence in the general population and subpopulations. The central question was to determine the current prevalence of HBV infection in Cameroon and identify factors contributing to variability in prevalence rates.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The evidence base included studies reporting HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) prevalence in the general population and subpopulations. A random-effects meta-analysis was used to generate pooled estimates of HBsAg prevalence, overall and for population subgroups. Heterogeneity was assessed using the index of heterogeneity (I 2 ). Quality was assessed using the Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tool. Out of 1236 records, 92 papers with 100 studies were included in the meta-analysis.

The prevalences for relatively lower-risk and higher-risk populations were 8.94% (95% CI 7.84-10.11) and 12.70% (95% CI 10.28-15.32), respectively. Overall, HBV prevalence remains high in Cameroon.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: In subgroup analyses, we found that sex, geographical area (regions), population risk groups and study design were the main sources of heterogeneity. The supplied evidence does not report on the specific genotypes of HBV in Cameroon or their distribution across subpopulations. The supplied evidence does not report on the mechanisms underlying the high prevalence of HBV in Cameroon.

The supplied evidence does not report on specific research priorities or policy recommendations for addressing HBV in Cameroon.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本研究旨在提供喀麦隆 HBV 患病率 的最新估计值。该综述的重点是人类 乙型肝炎病毒 感染、基因型和疾病,重点是一般人群和亚人群中的 患病率。核心问题是确定喀麦隆当前 HBV 感染的 患病率 并确定导致 患病率 率变异的因素。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 证据基础包括报告一般人群和亚人群中 HBV 表面抗原 (HBsAg) 患病率 的研究。使用随机效应荟萃分析生成 HBsAg 患病率 总体和人群亚组的汇总估计值。使用异质性指数(I 2 )评估异质性。使用乔安娜布里格斯研究所关键评估工具评估质量。在 1236 条记录中,荟萃分析纳入了 92 篇论文和 100 项研究。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 喀麦隆 HBV 总体 患病率 为 9.98%(95% 置信区间 [CI] 9.00-11.02),异质性较高 (I 2 = 98.10%)。相对较低风险和较高风险人群的 患病率 分别为 8.94% (95% CI 7.84-10.11) 和 12.70% (95% CI 10.28-15.32)。总体而言,喀麦隆的 HBV 患病率 仍然很高。

papers.source_body_en: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a global public health problem, and many regions of Sub-Saharan Africa are disproportionately affected, including Cameroon, where prevalence has previously been shown to be high. This study aimed to provide up-to-date estimates of HBV prevalence in Cameroon. We searched Medline, Global Health, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Africa Index Medicus and the Journal of Health Science and Disease at the University of Yaounde. We included studies reporting HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) prevalence in the general population and subpopulations. A random-effects meta-analysis was used to generate pooled estimates of HBsAg prevalence, overall and for population subgroups including those considered at relatively higher-risk and relatively lower-risk of HBV infection. Heterogeneity was assessed using the index of heterogeneity (I 2 ). Quality was assessed using the Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tool. Out of 1236 records, 92 papers with 100 studies were included in the meta-analysis. Overall prevalence of HBV in Cameroon was 9.98% (95% confidence interval [CI] 9.00-11.02) with high heterogeneity (I 2 = 98.10%). The prevalences for relatively lower-risk and higher-risk populations were8.94% (95% CI 7.84-10.11) and 12.70% (95% CI 10.28-15.32), respectively. In subgroup analyses, we found that sex, geographical area (regions), population risk groups and study design were the main sources of heterogeneity. Overall, HBV prevalence remains high in Cameroon. Our findings suggest an urgent need for health interventions to halt the spread of the disease, with particular attention needed for males and regions with the highest prevalence.

papers.title: ALG-020572, an Antisense Oligonucleotide for the Treatment of Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infection Discontinued for Drug-Induced Liver Injury.
papers.abstract: Current treatment options for chronic HBV infection are suboptimal in that they fail to suppress HBsAg levels. ALG-020572 is an antisense oligonucleotide designed to reduce viral protein synthesis through degradation of HBV mRNA. ALG-020572-401 was a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial consisting of two parts. Part 1 (single-ascending doses) evaluated the pharmacokinetics, safety and tolerability of single doses of ALG-020572 or placebo in healthy participants. In Part 2 (multiple dosing), participants with non-cirrhotic HBeAg-negative, virologically suppressed chronic HBV infection were administered up to 7 doses of ALG-020572 to evaluate safety, pharmacokinetics and antiviral activity. In Part 1, 32 participants were randomized to ALG 020572 or placebo. Single doses of ALG-020572 up to 480 mg were well tolerated. The most common treatment-emergent adverse event reported was injection site reaction. ALG-020572 was rapidly absorbed and plasma exposures increased with dose. In Part 2, 8 participants with non-cirrhotic HBeAg-negative virologically suppressed chronic hepatitis B infection were enrolled and received up to 7 doses of ALG-020572. The study was prematurely discontinued after 4 participants experienced significant alanine aminotransferase elevations that were subsequently attributed to drug-induced liver injury. Single doses of ALG-020572 demonstrated a favourable pharmacokinetic and safety profile in healthy participants. Unexpectedly, ALG-020572 was poorly tolerated in participants with chronic HBV infection, resulting in the early termination of the study and further development of ALG-020572 due to idiosyncratic drug-induced liver injury, suggesting caution is required in the development of this class of drugs. Trial Registration: Registered at clinicaltrials.gov: NCT0500102.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the safety and antiviral activity of ALG-020572, an antisense oligonucleotide targeting HBV mRNA, in patients with chronic HBV infection. The trial was divided into two parts: Part 1 assessed single-ascending doses in healthy participants, while Part 2 involved participants with non-cirrhotic HBeAg-negative, virologically suppressed chronic HBV infection. ALG-020572 demonstrated a favorable pharmacokinetic and safety profile in healthy individuals but was poorly tolerated in HBV-infected participants, leading to the early termination of the study due to drug-induced liver injury. The findings highlight the need for caution in developing antisense oligonucleotides for HBV treatment, as they may pose significant safety risks. The study's limitations include its premature discontinuation and small sample size, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 目前针对慢性 HBV 感染的 治疗 方案并不理想,因为它们无法抑制 HBsAg 水平。该研究旨在评估 ALG-020572 在慢性 HBV 感染患者中的安全性和 抗病毒药物 活性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: ALG-020572-401 是一项双盲、随机、安慰剂对照试验,由两部分组成。第 1 部分评估了 32 名健康参与者的单剂量,第 2 部分涉及 8 名非肝硬化 HBeAg 阴性、病毒学抑制的慢性 HBV 感染参与者。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究通过单次递增剂量和多次给药对慢性 HBV 感染参与者评估 ALG-020572 的药代动力学、安全性、耐受性和 抗病毒药物 活性。
elements_zh.main_results: 报告的最常见 治疗 相关新发不良事件为注射部位反应。单次剂量的 ALG-020572 在健康受试者中显示出良好的药代动力学和安全性特征。然而,在4名受试者因药物诱导性肝损伤出现显著丙氨酸氨基转移酶升高后,研究被提前终止。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,慢性 HBV 感染参与者对 ALG-020572 的耐受性较差,导致提前终止,并强调开发此类药物需要谨慎。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果提醒人们在开发针对乙型肝炎病毒的反义寡核苷酸时需谨慎,因其存在药物诱导性肝损伤风险,这对未来药物设计和安全性评估具有重要意义。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于安全问题,该研究提前终止,这限制了全面评估长期疗效和安全性的能力。由于样本量有限且提前终止,证据不充分。

In Part 2 (multiple dosing), participants with non-cirrhotic HBeAg-negative, virologically suppressed chronic HBV infection were administered up to 7 doses of ALG-020572 to evaluate safety, pharmacokinetics and antiviral activity. In Part 1, 32 participants were randomized to ALG 020572 or placebo. Single doses of ALG-020572 up to 480 mg were well tolerated. The most common treatment-emergent adverse event reported was injection site reaction. ALG-020572 was rapidly absorbed and plasma exposures increased with dose. In Part 2, 8 participants with non-cirrhotic HBeAg-negative virologically suppressed chronic hepatitis B infection were enrolled and received up to 7 doses of ALG-020572. The study was prematurely discontinued after 4 participants experienced significant alanine aminotransferase elevations that were subsequently attributed to drug-induced liver injury. Single doses of ALG-020572 demonstrated a favourable pharmacokinetic and safety profile in healthy participants. Unexpectedly, ALG-020572 was poorly tolerated in participants with chronic HBV infection, resulting in the early termination of the study and further development of ALG-020572 due to idiosyncratic drug-induced liver injury, suggesting caution is required in the development of this class of drugs. papers.title: Next-Generation Sequencing Methods for Sensitive Hepatitis B Viral Genome Analysis: A European Study.
papers.abstract: This multicentre study investigated the utility of next-generation sequencing (NGS) to detect and generate hepatitis B virus (HBV) genomes in samples of low viral load (from 0.2 to 6207 IU/mL). 23 HBV DNA-positive plasma samples of genotypes A-E and one HBV-negative control sample were assayed blindly via 9 established NGS methods from 6 European laboratories. Methods included untargeted metagenomics, pre-enrichment by probe-capture followed by Illumina sequencing, and HBV-specific PCR pre-amplification followed by sequencing with Nanopore or Illumina. Full HBV genomes were obtained only from samples with viral loads > 1000 IU/mL using probe-capture methods, > 200 IU/mL using PCR-Illumina methods, > 10 IU/mL using PCR-Nanopore methods, and in no samples using metagenomic methods. Contamination was observed in the negative control and samples with very low viral loads in PCR-based methods. Probe-capture and metagenomic methods detected additional viruses not routinely screened in blood donations, including polyomaviruses and herpesviruses; positive results were confirmed by PCR. In conclusion, NGS may delineate whole-genome sequences at low viral loads if supported by a PCR pre-amplification step. Probe-capture methods also reliably detect HBV without pre-amplification but show limited genome coverage for samples with low viral loads; they may additionally detect a wide range of blood-borne viruses.

Full HBV genomes were obtained only from samples with viral loads > 1000 IU/mL using probe-capture methods, > 200 IU/mL using PCR-Illumina methods, > 10 IU/mL using PCR-Nanopore methods, and in no samples using metagenomic methods. Contamination was observed in the negative control and samples with very low viral loads in PCR-based methods. Probe-capture and metagenomic methods detected additional viruses not routinely screened in blood donations, including polyomaviruses and herpesviruses; positive results were confirmed by PCR. In conclusion, NGS may delineate whole-genome sequences at low viral loads if supported by a PCR pre-amplification step. Probe-capture methods also reliably detect HBV without pre-amplification but show limited genome coverage for samples with low viral loads; they may additionally detect a wide range of blood-borne viruses.

analysis.summary_en: This European multicentre study evaluated the utility of next-generation sequencing (NGS) in detecting hepatitis B virus (HBV) genomes in samples with low viral loads. The research aimed to address the challenge of accurately identifying HBV in clinical settings where viral load is minimal. Methods included untargeted metagenomics, probe-capture followed by Illumina sequencing, and HBV-specific PCR pre-amplification combined with sequencing using either Nanopore or Illumina technologies. Full HBV genomes were obtained from samples with viral loads > 1000 IU/mL using probe-capture methods, > 200 IU/mL using PCR-Illumina methods, and > 10 IU/mL using PCR-Nanopore methods, while metagenomic methods failed to detect HBV in any samples. The study concluded that NGS can effectively generate whole-genome sequences of HBV at low viral loads when supported by a PCR pre-amplification step, which has important implications for improving diagnostic accuracy and informing better surveillance and treatment strategies. However, the study's results are limited by contamination observed in negative controls and low viral load samples using PCR-based methods, which may affect the reliability of findings in such cases. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the limited sample size and potential for contamination.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估下一代测序 (NGS) 在检测低病毒载量样本中的 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 基因组 方面的有效性,解决在病毒载量极低的临床环境中准确识别 HBV 的挑战。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项在 6 个欧洲实验室进行的多中心研究使用各种 NGS 方法评估了 23 份基因型 A-E 的 HBV DNA 阳性血浆样本和一份 HBV 阴性对照样本。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用了非靶向宏基因组学、探针捕获后进行 Illumina 测序,以及 HBV 特异性 PCR 预扩增,并结合使用 Nanopore 或 Illumina 技术进行测序。
elements_zh.main_results: 使用探针捕获方法从病毒载量 > 1000 IU/mL、使用 PCR-Illumina 方法 > 200 IU/mL 和使用 PCR-Nanopore 方法 > 10 IU/mL 的样本中成功获得完整 HBV 基因组。宏基因组方法未能在任何样本中检测到 HBV。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究表明,在 PCR 预扩增步骤的支持下,NGS 可以在低病毒载量下有效生成 HBV 的全 基因组 序列,强调了这种方法在提高检测准确性方面的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现对于提高低病毒载量情况下 HBV 基因组 分析的敏感性具有重要意义,这可以提高诊断准确性并为更好的 监测 和 治疗 策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究结果受限于PCR方法在阴性对照和低病毒载量样本中观察到的污染,表明此类样本的结果解读可能面临挑战。

papers.title: Barriers to Hepatitis B Treatment: A Multicentre Cross-Sectional Registry and Survey Study by the Canadian Hepatitis B Network.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a leading cause of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) worldwide, yet treatment uptake is suboptimal even in high-resource settings. This pan-Canadian study aimed to quantify treatment gaps within the Canadian Hepatitis B Network (CanHepB) Registry, compare characteristics of treatment-eligible but untreated patients to those receiving therapy, and assess patient and specialist perspectives on barriers to treatment. METHODS: A cross-sectional, retrospective analysis of 1983 adults with CHB followed in 18 Canadian hepatitis B specialty clinics between January 2018 and November 2024. Treatment eligibility was determined using the 2018 Canadian Association for the Study of the Liver guidelines. An anonymous survey captured patient-reported barriers and perspectives (n = 191), while a separate survey evaluated specialist perceptions (n = 54). RESULTS: Among 881 untreated patients, 46.4% (n = 409) were treatment eligible. Compared with the treatment group (n = 1087), the treatment-eligible but untreated patients were younger (median 47.3 vs. 54.5 years), more frequently female (54.2% vs. 39.7%), and more likely to be of Black/African/Caribbean origin (18.2% vs. They had a lower prevalence of cirrhosis (2.4% vs. 20.3%), HCC (0.7% vs. 9.3%), and hypertension (17.1% vs. 22.9%), but a higher prevalence of steatotic liver disease (36.4% vs. 24.6%) and dyslipidemia (14.7% vs. Among untreated respondents, concerns included side effects, the need for long-term therapy, and lack of curative options. Conversely, specialists identified cost as the primary barrier and side effects as the least concerning. CONCLUSION: This nationwide study reveals a significant treatment gap in CHB care, driven by demographic disparities and a mismatch between patient concerns and clinician perceptions.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景与目的:慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 仍然是全世界肝硬化和肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的主要原因,但即使在资源丰富的环境中,治疗 的摄取也不是最佳的。这项泛加拿大研究旨在量化加拿大乙型肝炎网络 (CanHepB) 注册中心内的 治疗 差距,比较符合 治疗 资格但未经治疗的患者与正在接受治疗的患者的特征,并评估患者和专家对 治疗 障碍的看法。方法:对 2018 年 1 月至 2024 年 11 月期间加拿大 18 个乙型肝炎专科诊所的 1983 名成人慢性乙型肝炎患者进行横断面回顾性分析。治疗 资格是根据 2018 年加拿大肝脏研究协会指南确定的。一项匿名调查记录了患者报告的障碍和观点 (n = 191),而另一项调查评估了专家的看法 (n = 54)。结果:在 881 名未经治疗的患者中,46.4% (n = 409) 符合 治疗 资格。与 治疗 组 (n = 1087) 相比,符合 治疗 条件但未接受治疗的患者更年轻(中位年龄 47.3 岁 vs. 54.5 岁),女性更常见(54.2% vs. 39.7%),并且更有可能是黑人/非洲/加勒比裔(18.2% vs. 他们的 患病率 较低)肝硬化(2.4% vs. 20.3%)、肝癌(0.7% vs. 9.3%)和高血压(17.1% vs. 22.9%),但脂肪变性肝病(36.4% vs. 24.6%)和血脂异常(14.7% vs. 未治疗的受访者)的 患病率 较高。在未治疗的受访者中,担忧包括副作用、需要长期治疗以及缺乏治疗。相反,专家认为成本是主要障碍,而副作用是最不令人担忧的。这项全国性研究揭示了慢性乙型肝炎护理中存在显着的 治疗 差距,这是由人口差异以及患者关注点和临床医生认知之间的不匹配造成的。

papers.title: Evaluation of the Virucidal Activity of Chlorine Dioxide against Hepatitis B Virus
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major global public health concern, with numerous nosocomial and occupational outbreaks reported. Preventing indirect HBV transmission through effective disinfection is crucial. This study evaluated the virucidal activity of chlorine dioxide (ClO2) against HBV and compared it with sodium hypochlorite (NaClO). Pretreatment of HBV with ClO2 at 10, 100, and 250 ppm (mg/L) for 1 min reduced hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) release to 65.5%, 21.9%, and 7.0%; hepatitis B core (HBc)-positive cells to 59.1%, 27.0%, and 6.6%; intracellular HBV RNA to 71.5%, 31.6%, and 3.0%; and extracellular HBV DNA to 82.2%, 42.6%, and 14.1%, respectively. At identical concentrations, NaClO produced smaller reductions. In the presence of organic matter, no significant reduction in ClO2 activity against HBV was observed. ClO2 demonstrated approximately 2.2-fold greater anti-HBV potency than NaClO with and without bovine serum albumin and sheep erythrocytes. Neutralizer, cell-permissiveness, and ultrafiltration controls supported direct viral inactivation. These findings indicate that ClO2 showed stronger in vitro anti-HBV activity than NaClO within the tested concentration range and conditions.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the virucidal activity of chlorine dioxide (ClO2) against Hepatitis B virus (HBV) and compared it with sodium hypochlorite (NaClO). The research aimed to address the need for effective disinfection methods to prevent HBV transmission. The study demonstrated that ClO2 significantly reduced HBV markers at various concentrations, with a 2.2-fold greater potency than NaClO. These results suggest that ClO2 may be a more effective disinfectant for HBV in certain conditions. However, the presence of organic matter did not significantly affect ClO2's activity. The study's in vitro design limits its direct applicability to real-world scenarios, and further research is needed to validate these results in vivo.

papers.abstract: Chronic Hepatitis B disease requires lifelong monitoring to prevent complications such as cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. Despite structured care pathways, non-attendance within UK secondary care remains challenging. This scoping review aimed to synthesise existing evidence on factors influencing non-attendance at secondary care appointments and strategies to improve appointment adherence among people living with Chronic Hepatitis B. Eligibility Criteria: Peer-reviewed sources examining adults with Hepatitis B attendance at UK secondary care services. Grey literature was excluded. Sources of Evidence: Searches were performed in CINAHL Ultimate, Medline, Embase, Scopus and APA PsycINFO. Data were charted using a structured data extraction form and synthesised narratively. Eleven studies met the inclusion criteria. Identified barriers included patient-related factors (e.g., limited health literacy, stigmatisation, competing priorities), system-level challenges (e.g., appointment scheduling and accessibility) and cultural or language barriers. Psychological factors, including fear of diagnosis and treatment side effects, were also reported. Reported strategies included patient education, culturally tailored interventions, reminder systems (e.g., SMS and telephone calls) and integrated care models involving community outreach. Non-attendance among people with chronic Hepatitis B in secondary care is influenced by a complex interplay of personal, social and systemic factors. Interventions that address multiple barriers, particularly those that incorporate culturally sensitive approaches and reminder systems, may improve engagement. Further research is needed to co-design and evaluate interventions with affected communities.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines non-attendance at secondary care appointments among adults with chronic hepatitis B in the UK, focusing on factors influencing appointment adherence and strategies to improve engagement. The central question addresses the interplay of patient, social, and systemic barriers to attendance and intervention approaches within UK secondary care pathways.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This scoping review searched CINAHL Ultimate, Medline, Embase, Scopus, and APA PsycINFO for peer-reviewed studies on adults with hepatitis B attending UK secondary care services, excluding grey literature. Eleven studies were included, and data were charted using a structured extraction form with narrative synthesis.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Non-attendance is driven by patient-related factors (e.g., limited health literacy, stigmatisation, competing priorities), system-level challenges (e.g., scheduling and accessibility), cultural or language barriers, and psychological factors such as fear of diagnosis and treatment side effects. Strategies like patient education, culturally tailored interventions, reminder systems (e.g., SMS and telephone calls), and integrated care models involving community outreach may improve engagement.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review does not report pooled estimates or comparative effectiveness of interventions, leaving uncertainty about the magnitude of impact for strategies such as reminder systems or culturally tailored approaches. Additionally, the evidence base is limited to 11 studies, and the synthesis does not address heterogeneity in intervention design or population characteristics.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Priority research should co-design and evaluate interventions with affected communities to address multifactorial barriers. Surveillance and practice should prioritise culturally sensitive approaches and reminder systems, while integrating community outreach into secondary care pathways to enhance appointment adherence.

analysis.summary_en: This scoping review synthesises evidence on non-attendance at UK secondary care appointments among adults with chronic hepatitis B, identifying multifactorial barriers including patient-related issues (e.g., health literacy, stigmatisation), system-level challenges (e.g., scheduling), cultural barriers, and psychological factors (e.g., fear of diagnosis). Reported strategies to improve engagement include patient education, culturally tailored interventions, reminder systems (e.g., SMS, telephone calls), and integrated care models with community outreach. The evidence base consists of 11 studies synthesised narratively, with no pooled estimates or comparative effectiveness data. Key gaps include limited evidence on intervention heterogeneity and the absence of quantified impacts. Research priorities include co-designing and evaluating interventions with affected communities, while practice should prioritise culturally sensitive approaches and reminder systems within integrated care models.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该范围界定综述检索了 CINAHL Ultimate、Medline、Embase、Scopus 和 APA PsycINFO,查找有关接受英国二级护理服务的成人乙型肝炎患者的同行评审研究,不包括灰色文献。其中包括十一项研究,并使用结构化提取形式和叙述综合来绘制数据图表。

elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该审查没有报告干预措施的汇总估计或比较有效性,从而使提醒系统或文化定制方法等策略的影响程度存在不确定性。此外,证据基础仅限于 11 项研究,并且综合并未解决干预设计或人群特征的异质性。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 优先研究应与受影响社区共同设计和评估干预措施,以解决多因素障碍。监测 和实践应优先考虑文化敏感的方法和提醒系统,同时将社区外展纳入二级护理途径,以提高预约依从性。

analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该范围界定综述检索了 CINAHL Ultimate、Medline、Embase、Scopus 和 APA PsycINFO,查找有关接受英国二级护理服务的成人乙型肝炎患者的同行评审研究,不包括灰色文献。其中包括十一项研究,并使用结构化提取形式和叙述综合来绘制数据图表。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 缺勤的原因包括患者相关因素(例如,有限的健康素养、污名化、相互竞争的优先事项)、系统层面的挑战(例如,日程安排和可及性)、文化或语言障碍以及心理因素,例如对 诊断 和 治疗 副作用的恐惧。患者教育、针对文化的干预措施、提醒系统(例如短信和电话)以及涉及社区外展的综合护理模式等策略可能会提高参与度。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该审查没有报告干预措施的汇总估计或比较有效性,从而使提醒系统或文化定制方法等策略的影响程度存在不确定性。此外,证据基础仅限于 11 项研究,并且综合并未解决干预设计或人群特征的异质性。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 优先研究应与受影响社区共同设计和评估干预措施,以解决多因素障碍。监测 和实践应优先考虑文化敏感的方法和提醒系统,同时将社区外展纳入二级护理途径,以提高预约依从性。

papers.title: Hepatitis B and C Prevention, Screening, and Diagnostic Services at HIV Treatment Sites: International Epidemiology Databases to Evaluate AIDS.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Prevention, screening, and diagnostic services for hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) can prevent morbidity and mortality in people receiving HIV care. However, there is limited information about the availability of HBV and HCV services at HIV clinics globally. METHODS: The International epidemiology Databases to Evaluate AIDS (IeDEA) conducted surveys of service delivery and practices at participating HIV treatment centers from 7 regions. We used 2023 survey data to measure availability of HBV vaccination, HBV and HCV screening, HBV surface antigen (HBsAg), HBV DNA, HCV antibody, and HCV RNA testing. Multivariable logistic regression models were used to test associations of site characteristics with HBV and HCV services. RESULTS: HBV vaccination was available on-site at 67.7% of 204 HIV treatment sites. Screening for HBV and HCV at HIV care enrollment was reported by 72.1% and 50% of sites, respectively. HBsAg, HBV DNA, HCV antibody, and HCV RNA testing were available on-site at 77%, 47.6%, 61.8%, and 44.6% of sites, respectively. Sites serving predominately rural (vs. urban) populations were less likely to report on-site availability of HBV DNA [odds ratio (OR):0.07; 95% confidence interval: 0.01 to 0.68; P = 0.02], HCV antibody (OR = 0.18; 95% CI: 0.04 to 0.92; P = 0.04), and HCV RNA (OR = 0.10; 95% CI: 0.01 to 0.90; P = 0.04) testing. CONCLUSION: Life-saving services such as HBV vaccination, HBsAg, and HCV antibody testing were available on-site at most HIV treatment sites participating in the IeDEA network. Lower availability at rural sites suggests that expansion of services is important to eliminate HBV and HCV as public health problems in people receiving HIV care.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 和丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 的预防、筛查和诊断服务可以预防接受 HIV 护理的人群发病和 死亡率。然而,有关全球艾滋病毒诊所提供的乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎服务的信息有限。

papers.title_zh: HIV 治疗 网站的乙型和丙型肝炎预防、筛查和诊断服务:评估艾滋病的国际 流行病学 数据库。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Prevention, screening, and diagnostic services for hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) can prevent morbidity and mortality in people receiving HIV care. However, there is limited information about the availability of HBV and HCV services at HIV clinics globally. METHODS: The International epidemiology Databases to Evaluate AIDS (IeDEA) conducted surveys of service delivery and practices at participating HIV treatment centers from 7 regions. We used 2023 survey data to measure availability of HBV vaccination, HBV and HCV screening, HBV surface antigen (HBsAg), HBV DNA, HCV antibody, and HCV RNA testing. Multivariable logistic regression models were used to test associations of site characteristics with HBV and HCV services. RESULTS: HBV vaccination was available on-site at 67.7% of 204 HIV treatment sites. Screening for HBV and HCV at HIV care enrollment was reported by 72.1% and 50% of sites, respectively. HBsAg, HBV DNA, HCV antibody, and HCV RNA testing were available on-site at 77%, 47.6%, 61.8%, and 44.6% of sites, respectively. Sites serving predominately rural (vs. urban) populations were less likely to report on-site availability of HBV DNA [odds ratio (OR):0.07; 95% confidence interval: 0.01 to 0.68; P = 0.02], HCV antibody (OR = 0.18; 95% CI: 0.04 to 0.92; P = 0.04), and HCV RNA (OR = 0.10; 95% CI: 0.01 to 0.90; P = 0.04) testing. CONCLUSION: Life-saving services such as HBV vaccination, HBsAg, and HCV antibody testing were available on-site at most HIV treatment sites participating in the IeDEA network. Lower availability at rural sites suggests that expansion of services is important to eliminate HBV and HCV as public health problems in people receiving HIV care.

papers.title: Metabolic Risk Factors of Developing Liver Steatosis among Patients with Chronic Hepatitis B: A National Cohort from Romania
papers.abstract: Background and Aims: The coexistence of liver steatosis in patients with chronic viral hepatitis B (CHB) is growing relevant as the global epidemic of obesity and type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). The aim of this study was to identify the metabolic risk factors linked to steatotic liver disease (SLD) in Romanian patients with CHB. Methods: In this prospective study, we evaluated 320,000 individuals in the LIVE(RO)2 nationwide screening program in Romania from 2021 to 2023. The majority of the patients had undergone transient elastography using controlled attenuation parameter (CAP) to diagnose liver steatosis, and they belonged to vulnerable categories. Exclusion criteria included heavy alcohol consumption, any other liver disease unrelated to CHB, and the lack of CAP evaluation. Results: 5,321 individuals (1.67%) were found with CHB in the screening program. In the final analysis we included 1,970 patients, with a mean age of 55.87±13.84 years; 57.9% of them were males, with a mean body mass index (BMI) level of 27.26 kg/m2, and 61.9% of the patients were vulnerable. The prevalence of SLD was 42.2% in the group of vulnerable individuals, compared with non-vulnerable participants, who had a prevalence of SLD of 26.4%. Moreover, patients with vulnerable conditions have a higher prevalence of T2DM (11.5%), hypertension (41.3%), and raised BMI levels ≥25 kg/m2 (71.3%). In our study, vulnerable subjects had a higher prevalence of hepatitis B virus e antigen (HBeAg) positivity of 3%, and it was found to be a protective risk factor for hepatic steatosis development (aOR=0.397). Also, these patients had a higher prevalence of severe liver fibrosis (≥ F3) of 17.1%, compared with those non-vulnerable, with a prevalence of 9.7% of severe liver fibrosis. More than that, we find that the presence of HBeAg-positive increases the risk of severe liver fibrosis progression 6 times higher. Conclusions: In our study we found a prevalence of hepatic steatosis of 42.2% in the cohort of vulnerable untreated patients with CHB, and the prevalence of severe fibrosis was 17.1%. Presence of HBeAg-positive was found to be a protective risk factor for hepatic steatosis but accelerates the development of severe fibrosis along with T2DM, which is more common in the vulnerable CHB cohort.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the metabolic risk factors associated with liver steatosis in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) in Romania. It highlights that vulnerable individuals with CHB have a significantly higher prevalence of steatosis (42.2%) and severe fibrosis (17.1%) compared to non-vulnerable participants (26.4% and 9.7%, respectively). elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 随着全球肥胖和 2 型糖尿病 (T2DM) 的流行,慢性乙型病毒性肝炎 (CHB) 患者肝脏脂肪变性的共存变得越来越重要。本研究的目的是确定罗马尼亚慢性乙型肝炎患者中与脂肪变性肝病 (SLD) 相关的代谢危险因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本项前瞻性研究纳入罗马尼亚LIVE(RO)2全国筛查项目(2021-2023年)的320,000名受试者。最终分析纳入1,970名患者,平均年龄为55.87±13.84岁;其中57.9%为男性,平均体质指数(BMI)水平为27.26 kg/m2,61.9%的患者属于脆弱人群。
elements_zh.methods: 大多数患者接受了使用受控衰减参数(CAP)的瞬时弹性成像来诊断肝脏脂肪变性,他们属于易受影响的类别。HBeAg 阳性被发现是肝脂肪变性的一个保护性危险因素,但会加速严重纤维化以及 T2DM 的发展,这在易感 CHB 队列研究 中更为常见。
elements_zh.main_results: 筛查计划中发现 5,321 人 (1.67%) 患有慢性乙型肝炎。弱势群体中的 SLD 的 患病率 为 42.2%,而非弱势参与者的 SLD 的 患病率 为 26.4%。此外,病情脆弱的患者患有T2DM(11.5%)、高血压(41.3%)和BMI水平≥25 kg/m2(71.3%)的患病率较高。在我们的研究中,易感受试者的乙型肝炎病毒 e抗原(HBeAg)阳性率较高,为3%,并且发现它是肝脂肪变性发展的保护性危险因素(aOR=0.397)。此外,与非易感患者相比,这些患者的严重肝纤维化(≥ F3)患病率 较高,为 17.1%,患病率 为 9.7%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在我们的研究中,我们发现在易受治疗的慢性乙型肝炎患者的 队列研究 中,肝脂肪变性的 患病率 为 42.2%,而严重纤维化的 患病率 为 17.1%。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究结果可为弱势慢性乙型肝炎患者代谢并发症的针对性 监测 和风险评估策略提供信息。他们还强调了监测这些人群的 T2DM 和高血压对于降低肝纤维化进展风险的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖瞬时弹性成像来诊断肝脏脂肪变性,并且排除了重度饮酒或其他肝脏疾病的个体。由于研究的观察性质和潜在的混杂因素,证据的强度中等。

In our study, vulnerable subjects had a higher prevalence of hepatitis B virus e antigen (HBeAg) positivity of 3%, and it was found to be a protective risk factor for hepatic steatosis development (aOR=0.397). analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 随着全球肥胖和 2 型糖尿病 (T2DM) 的流行,慢性乙型病毒性肝炎 (CHB) 患者肝脏脂肪变性的共存变得越来越重要。本研究的目的是确定罗马尼亚慢性乙型肝炎患者中与脂肪变性肝病 (SLD) 相关的代谢危险因素。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本项前瞻性研究纳入罗马尼亚LIVE(RO)2全国筛查项目(2021-2023年)的320,000名受试者。最终分析纳入1,970名患者,平均年龄为55.87±13.84岁;其中57.9%为男性,平均体质指数(BMI)水平为27.26 kg/m2,61.9%的患者属于脆弱人群。

analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖瞬时弹性成像来诊断肝脏脂肪变性,并且排除了重度饮酒或其他肝脏疾病的个体。由于研究的观察性质和潜在的混杂因素,证据的强度中等。

papers.title: Risk-based hepatocellular carcinoma surveillance thresholds using a prediction score in Asian patients with chronic hepatitis B: a nationwide cohort study
papers.abstract: BACKGROUNDS/AIMS: This study aimed to quantify hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) incidence according to a validated prediction score and to define score-based cut-offs corresponding to surveillance-relevant incidence thresholds in Asian patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) receiving antiviral therapy. METHODS: We conducted a nationwide population-based cohort study using the Korean National Health Insurance Service database. Adults with CHB initiating nucleos(t)ide analogue therapy between 2012 and 2023 were included, hose with viral coinfections, prior malignancy, or decompensated cirrhosis were excluded. HCC risk was stratified using the HCC-RESCUE score. Incident HCC was the primary outcome. Annual HCC incidence rates and adjusted hazard ratios were estimated using multivariable Cox proportional hazards models. RESULTS: Among 199,143 treated patients (median follow-up, 7.3 years), 15,233 developed HCC. Adjusted annual HCC incidence increased progressively across risk strata: 0.31% (95% CI 0.24-0.40) in the low-risk group, 1.09% (0.84-1.41) in the intermediate-risk group, and 1.85% (1.44-2.40) in the high-risk group. Compared with the low-risk group, adjusted hazard ratios for HCC were 3.48 (95% CI 3.35-3.61) and 5.90 (5.62-6.19) in the intermediate- and high-risk groups, respectively (all p<0.001). HCC-RESCUE scores corresponding to annual HCC incidence thresholds of 0.2%, 1.5%, and 3.0% were 47, 66, and 90. CONCLUSIONS: In a large antiviral-treated Asian CHB population, prediction score-based stratification revealed a graded spectrum of residual HCC risk and identified incidence-aligned thresholds relevant to surveillance. These findings support incidence-informed refinement of HCC surveillance strategies that complement traditional cirrhosis-based criteria in the antiviral treatment era.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 仍然是肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的主要原因,但 监测 策略通常基于肝硬化而不是个体化风险。该研究解决了通过经过验证的预测评分量化 HCC 发病率 的需要,并确定治疗的亚洲 CHB 患者中与 监测 相关的截止值。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用韩国国民健康保险服务数据库进行了一项基于全国人口的 队列研究 研究。2012 年至 2023 年间开始接受核苷(酸)类似物治疗的慢性乙型肝炎成人患者被包括在内,而那些患有病毒合并感染、既往恶性肿瘤或失代偿性肝硬化的患者则被排除在外。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 HCC-RESCUE 评分对 HCC 风险进行分层,HCC 事件是主要结局。使用多变量 Cox 比例风险模型估算年度 HCC 发病率 率和调整后的风险比。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 199,143 名接受治疗的患者中(中位随访时间为 7.3 年),15,233 名患者发展为 HCC。调整后的年度 HCC 发病率 在不同风险层中逐渐增加:低风险组为 0.31% (95% CI 0.24–0.40),中风险组为 1.09% (0.84–1.41),高风险组为 1.85% (1.44–2.40)。

papers.title_zh: 使用亚洲 慢性乙型肝炎 患者的预测评分确定基于风险的肝细胞癌 监测 阈值:一项全国性 队列研究 研究
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUNDS/AIMS: This study aimed to quantify hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) incidence according to a validated prediction score and to define score-based cut-offs corresponding to surveillance-relevant incidence thresholds in Asian patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) receiving antiviral therapy. METHODS: We conducted a nationwide population-based cohort study using the Korean National Health Insurance Service database. Adults with CHB initiating nucleos(t)ide analogue therapy between 2012 and 2023 were included, hose with viral coinfections, prior malignancy, or decompensated cirrhosis were excluded. HCC risk was stratified using the HCC-RESCUE score. Incident HCC was the primary outcome. Annual HCC incidence rates and adjusted hazard ratios were estimated using multivariable Cox proportional hazards models. RESULTS: Among 199,143 treated patients (median follow-up, 7.3 years), 15,233 developed HCC. Adjusted annual HCC incidence increased progressively across risk strata: 0.31% (95% CI 0.24-0.40) in the low-risk group, 1.09% (0.84-1.41) in the intermediate-risk group, and 1.85% (1.44-2.40) in the high-risk group. Compared with the low-risk group, adjusted hazard ratios for HCC were 3.48 (95% CI 3.35-3.61) and 5.90 (5.62-6.19) in the intermediate- and high-risk groups, respectively (all p<0.001). HCC-RESCUE scores corresponding to annual HCC incidence thresholds of 0.2%, 1.5%, and 3.0% were 47, 66, and 90. CONCLUSIONS: In a large antiviral-treated Asian CHB population, prediction score-based stratification revealed a graded spectrum of residual HCC risk and identified incidence-aligned thresholds relevant to surveillance. These findings support incidence-informed refinement of HCC surveillance strategies that complement traditional cirrhosis-based criteria in the antiviral treatment era.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目的:本研究旨在根据经过验证的预测评分量化肝细胞癌 (HCC) 发病率,并定义接受 抗病毒药物 治疗的亚洲 监测 (CHB) 患者中与 监测 相关 发病率 阈值相对应的基于评分的截止值。方法:我们利用韩国国民健康保险服务数据库进行了一项全国范围内的 队列研究 研究。纳入 2012 年至 2023 年间开始核苷(酸)类似物治疗的 CHB 成人,排除病毒合并感染、既往恶性肿瘤或失代偿性肝硬化。使用 HCC-RESCUE 评分对 HCC 风险进行分层。HCC 事件是主要结局。使用多变量 Cox 比例风险模型估算年度 HCC 发病率 率和调整后的风险比。结果:在 199,143 名接受治疗的患者中(中位随访时间为 7.3 年),15,233 名患者发展为 HCC。调整后的年度 HCC 发病率 在不同风险层中逐渐增加:低风险组为 0.31% (95% CI 0.24-0.40),中风险组为 1.09% (0.84-1.41),高风险组为 1.85% (1.44-2.40)。与低风险组相比,中风险组和高风险组的 HCC 调整后风险比分别为 3.48 (95% CI 3.35-3.61) 和 5.90 (5.62-6.19)(均 p<0.001)。对应于年度 HCC 发病率 阈值 0.2%、1.5% 和 3.0% 的 HCC-RESCUE 评分分别为 47、66 和 90。结论:在大量接受 发病率 治疗的亚洲 CHB 人群中,基于预测评分的分层揭示了残余 HCC 风险的分级谱,并确定了与监测。这些发现支持 HCC 监测 策略的 发病率 知情细化,补充了 抗病毒药物 治疗 时代传统的基于肝硬化的标准。

papers.title: Genomic and transcriptomic features of HBV integration in treatment-naïve, HBeAg-positive children with chronic HBV infection
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) integration represents a major obstacle to curing HBV; however, the landscape of HBV integration and local immune response to transcriptionally active viral integration in children with chronic HBV infection remain unclear. Herein, we aimed to elucidate this landscape in this population. METHODS: Genomic analyses using a probe-based capture strategy were performed on 18 children and 28 adults with chronic HBV infection. Spatial transcriptomics (ST) was performed on 12 children from our cohort and 3 adults from a public database. FINDINGS: All patients were hepatitis B e antigen (HBeAg)-positive and treatment-naïve. Genomically, children exhibited significantly lower clonal expansion level of HBV-integrated hepatocytes than adults, despite comparable unique breakpoint counts. After adjusting for confounding variables, age was identified as an independent risk factor for total frequency of unique integration breakpoints (b = 3.22, P = 0.005). Spatially, ST revealed that spots with transcriptionally active viral integration exhibited a sparse distribution and accounted for a low proportion of all spots in children. Notably, at these spots, children showed reduced adaptive immune cells (e.g., CD8+ T cells) but increased innate components (myeloid cells, Kupffer cells, activated dendritic cells) and APC co-stimulation, whereas adults exhibited a uniform reduction of immune cell populations. INTERPRETATION: Compared with adults, children exhibit lower clonal expansion of HBV-integrated hepatocytes and distinct immune profiles in response to transcriptionally active viral integration, offering new insights into their differing clinical course. FUNDING: Key Laboratory of Molecular Biology for Infectious Diseases (Ministry of Education).

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated HBV integration and local immune responses in treatment-naïve, HBeAg-positive children with chronic HBV infection compared to adults. Using genomic and spatial transcriptomic analyses, researchers found that children had significantly lower clonal expansion of HBV-integrated hepatocytes than adults despite similar numbers of unique integration breakpoints. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 儿童中的 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染对治疗提出了独特的挑战,但该人群中 HBV 整合和局部 免疫应答 与转录活性病毒整合的情况仍知之甚少。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用基于探针的捕获策略对 18 名患有慢性 HBV 感染的儿童和 28 名成人进行基因组分析,并对来自 队列研究 的 12 名儿童和来自公共数据库的 3 名成人进行空间转录组学。
elements_zh.methods: 使用基于探针的捕获策略进行基因组分析,并进行空间转录组学以评估转录活性和免疫细胞概况。
elements_zh.main_results: 尽管独特的断点数量相当,但儿童的 HBV 整合肝细胞克隆扩增明显低于成人,而且转录活性病毒整合点分布稀疏,占儿童所有点的比例较低。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 儿童表现出适应性免疫细胞减少,但转录活性整合位点的先天成分和 APC 共刺激增加,与表现出免疫细胞群均匀减少的成年人形成鲜明对比,这为 HBV 整合和 免疫应答 中与年龄相关的差异提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了乙型肝炎病毒整合和免疫微环境的年龄依赖性差异,这可能为监测和治疗儿童慢性乙型肝炎病毒感染的策略提供参考。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 年龄被确定为独特积分断点总频率的独立风险因素,表明超出研究的 队列研究 的潜在混淆和限制普遍性。

papers.title: Natural immune escape mutations in the envelope proteins of hepatitis B virus (HBV) regulate the assembly and infectivity of human hepatitis delta virus (HDV)
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The study examined how 35 natural immune escape mutations (IEMs) of hepatitis B virus (HBV) located in the major antigenic loop (MAL) of the envelope proteins regulate the assembly and infectivity of the natural sub-viral agent of HBV, hepatitis delta virus (HDV). All IEMs were permissive for the assembly and secretion of HDV virions. Only seven IEMs resulted in considerably decreased levels of secreted HDV virions in the context of one to three tested HBV genotypes, B, C, or D. The effects of IEMs on HDV infectivity were much more pronounced than on the assembly. Thirteen IEMs considerably inhibited the infectivity of HDV virions. All of them greatly reduced both the levels of HDV RNA genomes accumulated in the infected cells and the percentage of HDV-infected cells. Only one mutant R(169)P generated completely non-infectious HDV virions. Our analysis of the IEMs-mediated effects on the HDV life cycle therefore identified a number of critically important amino acid residues in the MAL, and aided the mechanistic understanding of the MAL functioning during the processes of HDV assembly and infectivity. The inhibition of either HDV assembly and/or infectivity is expected to suppress the viral spread and super-infection in vivo , and therefore to reduce the HDV reservoir in infected livers. Overall, the generated data showed that the anti-HBV immune response is capable of considerable down-regulation of the concomitant HDV infection by facilitating the selection for IEMs in the MAL. The study further advanced our understanding of the mechanisms of the complex HBV-HDV and HDV-host interactions. IMPORTANCE The study demonstrated that anti-hepatitis B virus (HBV) immune response via selection for the immune escape mutations (IEMs) in HBV envelope proteins (surface antigen, HBsAg) can considerably reduce the assembly and/or infectivity of hepatitis delta virus (HDV) virions coated with HBsAg. The IEMs could down-regulate concomitant HDV infection mostly via affecting HDV infectivity, which was considerably inhibited by 13 out of 35 IEMs. The HDV spread/super-infection, which are expected to be suppressed by inhibited via HBV-specific IEMs the assembly and/or infectivity of HDV virions, should result in a reduced HDV reservoir in infected livers. The examination of the inhibition of HDV infectivity by IEMs apparently indicated that the major antigenic loop (MAL) of HBsAg could contain the residues primarily involved in viral attachment/entry and also the residues mostly regulating intracellular post-entry trafficking of HDV virions. The data advance our understanding of the MAL functioning during infection and of the indirect regulation of the HDV life cycle through the anti-HBV immune response.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate how natural immune escape mutations (IEMs) in the envelope proteins of hepatitis B virus (HBV) affect the assembly and infectivity of hepatitis delta virus (HDV). The background highlights the importance of understanding these interactions to better comprehend the mechanisms of immune evasion and their impact on HDV.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed 35 natural immune escape mutations (IEMs) of HBV located in the major antigenic loop (MAL) of the envelope proteins. These mutations were tested in the context of one to three HBV genotypes, B, C, or D, to assess their effects on HDV assembly and infectivity.
analysis.methods: The researchers examined the effects of IEMs on HDV virion assembly and infectivity by assessing secreted HDV virion levels and HDV RNA genome accumulation in infected cells. They also evaluated the percentage of HDV-infected cells and the infectivity of HDV virions in the presence of these mutations.
analysis.main_results: Only seven IEMs resulted in considerably decreased levels of secreted HDV virions. Thirteen IEMs considerably inhibited HDV infectivity, greatly reducing both HDV RNA genomes accumulated in infected cells and the percentage of HDV-infected cells. One mutant, R(169)P, generated completely non-infectious HDV virions.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that IEMs in HBV can significantly down-regulate HDV infectivity, which is more pronounced than their effect on HDV assembly. This provides novel insights into the role of the MAL in HDV life cycle regulation and the potential of anti-HBV immune responses to influence HDV infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results contribute to the mechanistic understanding of HBV-HDV interactions and may inform strategies for targeting HDV through HBV-specific immune responses, potentially aiding in the development of therapies or vaccines that reduce HDV reservoirs in infected livers.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence is based on in vitro analysis of HBV genotypes and their effects on HDV, which may limit generalizability to in vivo conditions. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the absence of direct clinical or epidemiological data.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores how natural immune escape mutations (IEMs) in the envelope proteins of hepatitis B virus (HBV) influence the assembly and infectivity of hepatitis delta virus (HDV). It identifies that while all IEMs are permissive for HDV virion assembly, only seven significantly reduce secreted HDV levels. Thirteen IEMs inhibit HDV infectivity, with one mutant, R(169)P, generating completely non-infectious virions. The findings suggest that IEMs primarily affect HDV infectivity, which is more pronounced than their impact on assembly. This provides insights into the role of the major antigenic loop (MAL) in HDV life cycle regulation and highlights the potential of anti-HBV immune responses to suppress HDV infection. The study's results are of moderate strength due to their in vitro nature and limited in vivo data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探讨乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)包膜蛋白中的自然免疫逃逸突变(IEM)如何影响丁型肝炎病毒(HDV)的组装和感染性。这一背景强调了了解这些相互作用对于更好地理解免疫逃避机制及其对 HDV 的影响的重要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了位于包膜蛋白主要抗原环(MAL)中的 35 个 HBV 自然免疫逃逸 突变(IEM)。这些 突变 在一到三种 HBV 基因型(B、C 或 D)的背景下进行了测试,以评估它们对 HDV 组装和感染性的影响。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员通过评估感染细胞中分泌的 HDV 病毒粒子水平和 HDV RNA 基因组 积累,研究了 IEM 对 HDV 病毒粒子组装和感染性的影响。他们还评估了在这些 突变 存在下 HDV 感染细胞的百分比和 HDV 病毒颗粒的感染性。
elements_zh.main_results: 只有 7 个 IEM 导致分泌型 HDV 病毒粒子的水平显着降低。13 个 IEM 显着抑制了 HDV 的感染性,大大降低了感染细胞中积累的 HDV RNA 基因组 和 HDV 感染细胞的百分比。一种突变体 R(169)P 产生完全非传染性的 HDV 病毒体。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,HBV 中的 IEM 可以显着下调 HDV 感染性,这比它们对 HDV 组装的影响更为明显。这为了解 MAL 在 HDV 生命周期调节中的作用以及抗 HBV 免疫应答 影响 HDV 感染的潜力提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果有助于对 HBV-HDV 相互作用的机制理解,并可能为通过 HBV 特异性 免疫应答 靶向 HDV 的策略提供信息,可能有助于开发减少受感染肝脏中 HDV 免疫应答 的疗法或 疫苗。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据基于对 HBV 基因型及其对 HDV 影响的体外分析,这可能会限制其在体内条件下的普遍适用性。由于缺乏直接的临床或流行病学数据,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探讨乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)包膜蛋白中的自然免疫逃逸突变(IEM)如何影响丁型肝炎病毒(HDV)的组装和感染性。这一背景强调了了解这些相互作用对于更好地理解免疫逃避机制及其对 HDV 的影响的重要性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了位于包膜蛋白主要抗原环(MAL)中的 35 个 HBV 自然免疫逃逸 突变(IEM)。这些 突变 在一到三种 HBV 基因型(B、C 或 D)的背景下进行了测试,以评估它们对 HDV 组装和感染性的影响。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员通过评估感染细胞中分泌的 HDV 病毒粒子水平和 HDV RNA 基因组 积累,研究了 IEM 对 HDV 病毒粒子组装和感染性的影响。他们还评估了在这些 突变 存在下 HDV 感染细胞的百分比和 HDV 病毒颗粒的感染性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 只有 7 个 IEM 导致分泌型 HDV 病毒粒子的水平显着降低。13 个 IEM 显着抑制了 HDV 的感染性,大大降低了感染细胞中积累的 HDV RNA 基因组 和 HDV 感染细胞的百分比。一种突变体 R(169)P 产生完全非传染性的 HDV 病毒体。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,HBV 中的 IEM 可以显着下调 HDV 感染性,这比它们对 HDV 组装的影响更为明显。这为了解 MAL 在 HDV 生命周期调节中的作用以及抗 HBV 免疫应答 影响 HDV 感染的潜力提供了新的见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果有助于对 HBV-HDV 相互作用的机制理解,并可能为通过 HBV 特异性 免疫应答 靶向 HDV 的策略提供信息,可能有助于开发减少受感染肝脏中 HDV 免疫应答 的疗法或 疫苗。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据基于对 HBV 基因型及其对 HDV 影响的体外分析,这可能会限制其在体内条件下的普遍适用性。由于缺乏直接的临床或流行病学数据,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Immunization and the hepatitis B virus: A view from the ESPGHAN Hepatology Committee
papers.abstract: Abstract Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a global health challenge, with more than 250 million people chronically infected worldwide and >2000 daily deaths from HBV‐related disease. Early‐life acquisition is the primary driver of chronic infection; up to 90% of infants infected perinatally progress to chronic HBV infection compared with markedly lower rates in older children and adults. Universal infant immunization, including the birth‐dose, has been central to global elimination, resulting in a substantial reduction in chronic HBV infection, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Recent statements from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention question the evidence‐base for early‐life vaccination and recommend deferring HBV immunization until later in childhood. These claims reflect misconceptions about HBV epidemiology and reference a perceived association between infant vaccination and autism. This communication summarizes evidence demonstrating the risks of early‐life HBV transmission leading to chronic infection. We argue that delaying or foregoing immunization would leave infants at unnecessary risk. We reference two decades of research in which large‐scale studies have not identified an association between vaccination, including HBV vaccination, and autism.
papers.journal: Journal of Pediatric Gastroenterology and Nutrition

analysis.research_question_and_background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a global health challenge, with more than 250 million people chronically infected worldwide and >2000 daily deaths from HBV-related disease. The study addresses the need to clarify the role of early-life immunization in preventing chronic HBV infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a review of existing literature and evidence, focusing on human hepatitis B virus infection, genotypes and disease. It includes data on early-life acquisition of HBV and its association with chronic infection, as well as the impact of universal infant immunization.
analysis.methods: The authors conducted a review of the evidence base, including epidemiological data, clinical studies and public health reports, to assess the risks of early-life HBV transmission and the effectiveness of immunization strategies.
analysis.main_results: Early-life acquisition is the primary driver of chronic infection; up to 90% of infants infected perinatally progress to chronic HBV infection compared with markedly lower rates in older children and adults.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as evidence that early-life HBV transmission significantly increases the risk of chronic infection, and they argue that this underscores the importance of immunization in preventing such outcomes.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the necessity of maintaining universal infant immunization against HBV to reduce the incidence of chronic infection, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma, particularly in high-risk populations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a review of existing literature and does not present new data, which may limit its evidence strength. However, it references a substantial body of research supporting the safety and efficacy of early-life HBV immunization.

analysis.summary_en: This paper addresses the global health challenge posed by hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, emphasizing the critical role of early-life immunization in preventing chronic HBV infection. The authors review evidence showing that up to 90% of infants infected perinatally develop chronic HBV, highlighting the importance of universal infant vaccination. They also address recent claims questioning the evidence base for early vaccination, arguing that these reflect misconceptions and lack scientific support. The study underscores the necessity of maintaining immunization programs to reduce the burden of HBV-related diseases, such as cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. While the paper is based on a literature review, it references a large body of research supporting the safety and efficacy of HBV immunization. The authors conclude that delaying or foregoing immunization would leave infants at unnecessary risk, reinforcing the need for continued public health efforts.

papers.source_body_en: Abstract Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a global health challenge, with more than 250 million people chronically infected worldwide and >2000 daily deaths from HBV‐related disease. Early‐life acquisition is the primary driver of chronic infection; up to 90% of infants infected perinatally progress to chronic HBV infection compared with markedly lower rates in older children and adults. Universal infant immunization, including the birth‐dose, has been central to global elimination, resulting in a substantial reduction in chronic HBV infection, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Recent statements from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention question the evidence‐base for early‐life vaccination and recommend deferring HBV immunization until later in childhood. These claims reflect misconceptions about HBV epidemiology and reference a perceived association between infant vaccination and autism. This communication summarizes evidence demonstrating the risks of early‐life HBV transmission leading to chronic infection. We argue that delaying or foregoing immunization would leave infants at unnecessary risk. We reference two decades of research in which large‐scale studies have not identified an association between vaccination, including HBV vaccination, and autism.

papers.title: Awareness, knowledge, acceptance, and uptake of hepatitis B vaccines among healthcare workers in Nigeria: a scoping review
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B vaccines have been licensed for public use since the 20th century; however, many health workers in Nigeria are yet to recognise the importance of this notable scientific discovery. This scoping review aimed to assess the awareness, knowledge, acceptance, and uptake of hepatitis B vaccines among healthcare workers in Nigeria. The scoping review was reported using the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR) guidelines. Relevant peer-reviewed studies published from January 2021 to September 2025 were searched from five public databases using Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) terms, keywords, truncations and Boolean operators. The Population, Concept, Context (PCC) framework was used to design the inclusion criteria. Relevant data were extracted from each paper, and thematic analysis was done to summarise the findings. Twenty-two studies with a total sample size of 5,537 and all cross-sectional designs were included in the review. The studies were mainly from Southern Nigeria. The awareness of hepatitis B virus (HBV) vaccines among healthcare workers (HCWs) was described in nine studies and it ranged from 50.7% in Abuja to 100% in Kaduna State. The uptake of at least one dose of the vaccine was an outcome in sixteen studies and it ranged from 19.9% in Anambra State to 80% in Sokoto State. There was insufficient evidence on the knowledge and acceptance of HBV vaccines among HCWs in Nigeria, as only two studies reported on each theme. In conclusion, many healthcare workers in Nigeria were aware of effective vaccines for HBV, however, the uptake of these vaccines remained unsatisfactory in some regions.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines awareness, knowledge, acceptance, and uptake of hepatitis B virus (HBV) vaccines among healthcare workers (HCWs) in Nigeria, focusing on the central question of vaccine-related behaviors and determinants in this specific population and setting.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This scoping review followed PRISMA-ScR guidelines and searched five public databases from January 2021 to September 2025 using MeSH terms, keywords, truncations, and Boolean operators. Inclusion criteria were designed using the Population, Concept, Context (PCC) framework, and thematic analysis was performed to summarize findings from 22 cross-sectional studies with a total sample size of 5,537 HCWs.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review reports high variability in HBV vaccine awareness among HCWs in Nigeria, ranging from 50.7% to 100% across states, and unsatisfactory vaccine uptake in some regions, with rates as low as 19.9% and as high as 80%. It concludes that while awareness of HBV vaccines is present, uptake remains suboptimal in certain areas.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evidence base shows insufficient data on knowledge and acceptance of HBV vaccines among HCWs in Nigeria, with only two studies reporting on each theme. Additionally, the review highlights a geographic imbalance, as most included studies were from Southern Nigeria, leaving substantial regional gaps in evidence.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review underscores the need for targeted interventions to improve HBV vaccine uptake among HCWs in Nigeria, particularly in regions with low uptake, and calls for further research to address critical gaps in knowledge and acceptance assessments.

analysis.summary_en: This scoping review assesses awareness, knowledge, acceptance, and uptake of hepatitis B virus (HBV) vaccines among healthcare workers (HCWs) in Nigeria. Using PRISMA-ScR guidelines, it synthesized data from 22 cross-sectional studies involving 5,537 HCWs, primarily from Southern Nigeria. Findings reveal high variability in vaccine awareness (50.7% to 100%) and suboptimal uptake in some regions (19.9% to 80%). However, evidence on knowledge and acceptance is sparse, with only two studies addressing each theme. The review highlights geographic imbalances in study coverage and calls for targeted interventions to improve vaccine uptake and further research to fill critical knowledge gaps.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该评价调查了尼日利亚医护人员 (HCW) 对 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 疫苗 的认识、知识、接受度和采用情况,重点关注这一特定人群和环境中 疫苗 相关行为和决定因素的核心问题。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 此次范围界定审查遵循 PRISMA-ScR 指南,并使用 MeSH 术语、关键词、截断和布尔运算符搜索了 2021 年 1 月至 2025 年 9 月的五个公共数据库。纳入标准是使用人口、概念、背景 (PCC) 框架设计的,并进行了主题分析,总结了 22 项横断面研究的结果,总样本量为 5,537 名医护人员。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该审查报告称,尼日利亚医护人员对 HBV 疫苗 的认知存在很大差异,各州的认知度从 50.7% 到 100% 不等,而某些地区的 疫苗 知晓率并不令人满意,比率低至 19.9%,高至 80%。结论是,虽然存在对 HBV 疫苗 的认识,但某些地区的吸收率仍然不理想。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 证据基础显示,尼日利亚医护人员对 HBV 疫苗 的了解和接受程度的数据不足,只有两项研究报告了每个主题。此外,该审查强调了地理不平衡,因为大多数纳入的研究都来自尼日利亚南部,导致证据存在巨大的区域差距。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查强调需要采取有针对性的干预措施,以提高尼日利亚医护人员对 HBV 疫苗 的采用率,特别是在采用率较低的地区,并呼吁开展进一步研究,以解决知识和接受评估方面的关键差距。

papers.title: Peripheral Biomarkers in Chronic Hepatitis D Infection: A Review.
papers.abstract: Chronic hepatitis D represents the most severe form of viral hepatitis and is associated with higher rates of advanced fibrosis, cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma than hepatitis B monoinfection. It is caused by the hepatitis D virus (HDV), a defective RNA virus that requires co-infection with hepatitis B (HBV) for hepatocyte entry and propagation. Accurate prediction of liver disease sequelae and treatment response using currently available serological biomarkers remains challenging. This article reviews peripheral biomarkers in HDV, including novel biomarkers of HBV activity, exploring their potential clinical utility and areas for future development. Peripheral biomarkers capable of risk stratifying patients with HDV, monitoring or predicting treatment response and elucidating the natural history of infection (including the complex relationship with HBV), would enable individualised care and early identification of those at greater risk of developing advanced liver disease. Establishing the role of these biomarkers in larger, ethnically diverse populations both on existing treatments and in the context of emerging antiviral therapies will be imperative going forward.

papers.title: The Evolving Burden of Hepatitis B and C: Past Trends and Future Projections from the Global Burden of Disease Study 2021.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B and C continue to pose significant challenges to global public health, and this study is aimed at evaluating their burden. METHODS: Leveraging data from the Global Burden of Disease 2021, we analyzed age-standardized mortality rates (ASMRs) and age-standardized disability-adjusted life year rates (ASDRs) for hepatitis B and C from 1990 to 2021 using Joinpoint regression, age-period-cohort models, and decomposition analysis. Bayesian age-period-cohort models were applied to project future trends up to 2036. Additionally, we assessed the burden attributable to modifiable risk factors and its association with socioeconomic indicators. RESULTS: From 1990 to 2021, the global ASMR for hepatitis B declined from 12.19 to 7.57 per 100,000, and the ASMR for hepatitis C decreased from 8.18 to 6.10 per 100,000. Despite these decreases, the absolute numbers of deaths and DALYs continued to increase, mainly driven by population growth and aging. In 2021, males carried a disproportionately higher burden of hepatitis B and C compared to females. Moreover, countries with low socioeconomic development faced a greater burden. Notably, high alcohol consumption accounted for 16.20% of hepatitis B DALYs, while drug use was responsible for 49.49% of hepatitis C DALYs. By 2036, ASMRs are projected to decline further to 5.90 per 100,000 for hepatitis B and 5.23 per 100,000 for hepatitis C. analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the global burden of hepatitis B and C from 1990 to 2021 and projects trends to 2036 using Global Burden of Disease 2021 data. Age-standardized mortality rates for both viruses declined over the period, yet absolute deaths and disability-adjusted life years continued to rise primarily because of population growth and aging. Males and low-socioeconomic countries carried disproportionately higher burdens, with alcohol and drug use contributing substantially to hepatitis B and C disability, respectively. Projections indicate further declines in mortality rates by 2036. The authors conclude that sustained vaccination, antiviral treatment, and risk-factor control are essential to reduce the global burden.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎继续对全球公共卫生构成重大挑战,本研究旨在评估其负担。方法:利用 2021 年全球疾病负担的数据,我们使用 Joinpoint 回归、年龄周期 队列研究 模型和分解分析,分析了 1990 年至 2021 年乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎的年龄标准化 死亡率 率 (ASMR) 和年龄标准化伤残调整生命年率 (ASDR)。应用贝叶斯年龄周期 队列研究 模型来预测截至 2036 年的未来趋势。此外,我们评估了可改变的风险因素造成的负担及其与社会经济指标的关联。结果:从1990年到2021年,全球乙型肝炎ASMR从每10万人12.19下降到7.57,丙型肝炎ASMR从每10万人8.18下降到6.10。尽管出现这些下降,但死亡人数和伤残调整生命年的绝对人数继续增加,这主要是由人口增长和老龄化推动的。2021 年,与女性相比,男性的乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎负担要高得多。此外,社会经济发展水平较低的国家面临着更大的负担。值得注意的是,大量饮酒占乙型肝炎 DALY 的 16.20%,而吸毒则占丙型肝炎 DALY 的 49.49%。到 2036 年,乙型肝炎 ASMR 预计将进一步下降至每 100,000 人 5.90,丙型肝炎则进一步下降至每 100,000 人 5.23。结论:尽管 ASMR 和 ASDR 有所下降,但乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎的全球负担仍然相当大。继续努力疫苗接种、抗病毒药物、治疗以及控制关键风险因素至关重要,特别是在高负担人群中。
