papers.title: Examining Structural and Social Drivers of Hepatitis B Vaccination Across Diverse Clinical Settings
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Hepatitis B is a major cause of liver cancer in the United States and is also associated with increased risks of non-Hodgkin lymphoma, pancreatic, bile duct, and head and neck cancers. Although the Hepatitis B vaccine is highly effective at preventing chronic infection and subsequent cancer development, vaccination rates remain low: In 2021, Hepatitis B vaccination coverage was 34.2% among adults 19 and older. This study evaluates Hepatitis B vaccination series completion among adolescents and young adults across clinic settings, demographics, and social determinants of health (SDOH) to identify gaps in vaccine coverage and reduce the incidence of Hepatitis B infection and related cancers. Methods We performed a retrospective, cross-sectional analysis using electronic health record data from adolescent medicine, pediatric infectious diseases, internal medicine-pediatrics, and family medicine clinics within the University of South Florida health system, and Ybor Youth Clinic, a community sexual health clinic within the USF pediatrics department. The sample included 456 patients aged 16-24 who were seen between January and March 2025 and had documented immunization histories. Completion of the Hepatitis B vaccination series was analyzed by clinic type and demographic and SDOH variables, including age, gender, race, ethnicity, insurance status, primary language, primary care provider, HPV and tetanus vaccination status, and comorbid conditions. Results Across 20 clinics, 422 patients (92.5%) completed the Hepatitis B vaccination series. Completion rates varied significantly across clinic types (p=0.012). Demographic factors such as gender, race, and ethnicity were not significantly associated with vaccination status (p=0.092, p=0.787, p=0.956). However, younger patients were more likely to have completed the vaccine series (p<0.001). Uninsured patients demonstrated lower completion rates compared to those with public or private insurance (p=0.045). Completion of other routine vaccines (HPV series, tetanus, and tetanus booster) was strongly correlated with Hepatitis B vaccination completion (all p<0.001). Having a primary care provider was not significantly linked to completion (p=0.271), and comorbidities such as HIV infection showed no significant association (p=0.092, p=0.124). Conclusion Hepatitis B vaccination rates in this cohort were substantially higher than national averages. However, disparities persisted based on various SDOH factors. Structural and access-related factors, particularly clinic type and insurance coverage, were more predictive of vaccine completion than demographic characteristics, suggesting structural factors have a greater influence than patient attributes in determining vaccination status. These findings highlight the need for system-level interventions to support series completion, particularly among underserved populations, to support Hepatitis B prevention and mitigate cancer-related disparities.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨不同临床环境中乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 的结构和社会驱动因素,解决 疫苗接种 发病率低的公共卫生问题,尽管 疫苗 可有效预防慢性感染和相关癌症。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用南佛罗里达大学卫生系统内 20 个诊所的电子健康记录数据进行了回顾性横断面分析,这些诊所包括青少年医学、儿科传染病和社区性健康诊所。该研究纳入了 456 名年龄在 16 岁至 24 岁之间、有免疫史且在 2025 年 1 月至 3 月期间就诊的患者。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究按诊所类型以及人口统计和健康社会决定因素 (SDOH) 变量分析了乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 系列的完成情况,包括年龄、性别、种族、民族、保险状况、主要语言、初级保健提供者、HPV 和破伤风 疫苗接种 状态以及合并症。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 20 个诊所中,422 名患者 (92.5%) 完成了乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 系列。不同诊所类型的完成率差异很大 (p=0.012)。年轻患者更有可能完成 疫苗 系列 (p<0.001)。与拥有公共或私人保险的患者相比,未参保患者的完成率较低 (p=0.045)。其他常规 疫苗(HPV 系列、破伤风和破伤风加强疫苗)的完成与乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 的完成密切相关(所有 p<0.001)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,结构和访问相关因素,特别是诊所类型和保险范围,比人口特征更能预测 疫苗 的完成情况,表明结构因素对 疫苗接种 状态的影响比患者属性更大。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调需要采取系统级干预措施来支持乙型肝炎系列的完成,特别是在服务不足的人群中,以加强预防工作并减少与癌症相关的差异。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对电子健康记录数据的依赖而受到限制,这可能会引入偏差或缺失信息。由于该研究的观察性质以及存在未测量的混杂因素的可能性,证据强度适中。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 在美国,乙型肝炎是肝癌的主要原因,并且还与非霍奇金淋巴瘤、胰腺癌、胆管癌和头颈癌的风险增加有关。尽管乙型肝炎 疫苗 在预防慢性感染和随后的癌症发展方面非常有效,但 疫苗接种 比率仍然很低:2021 年,乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 在 19 岁及以上成年人中的覆盖率为 34.2%。本研究评估青少年和年轻人在临床环境、人口统计和健康社会决定因素 (SDOH) 方面的乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 系列完成情况,以确定 疫苗 覆盖范围的差距,并减少乙型肝炎感染和相关癌症的 发病率。方法 我们使用来自南佛罗里达大学卫生系统内的青少年医学、儿科传染病、内科儿科和家庭医学诊所以及南佛罗里达大学儿科内的社区性健康诊所 Ybor Youth Clinic 的电子健康记录数据进行了回顾性横断面分析。该样本包括 456 名年龄在 16-24 岁之间的患者,他们在 2025 年 1 月至 3 月期间就诊,并有记录的免疫史。乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 系列的完成情况通过诊所类型、人口统计和 SDOH 变量进行分析,包括年龄、性别、种族、民族、保险状况、主要语言、初级保健提供者、HPV 和破伤风 疫苗接种 状态以及合并症。结果 20 个诊所中,422 名患者 (92.5%) 完成了乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 系列。不同诊所类型的完成率差异很大 (p=0.012)。性别、种族和族裔等人口统计因素与 疫苗接种 状态没有显着相关性 (p=0.092、p=0.787、p=0.956)。然而,年轻患者更有可能完成 疫苗 系列 (p<0.001)。与拥有公共或私人保险的患者相比,未参保的患者的完成率较低 (p=0.045)。其他常规 疫苗(HPV 系列、破伤风和破伤风加强疫苗)的完成与乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 的完成密切相关(所有 p<0.001)。拥有初级保健提供者与完成治疗没有显着相关性(p=0.271),并且 HIV 感染等合并症也没有显示出显着关联(p=0.092,p=0.124)。结论 本次队列研究中乙型肝炎疫苗接种发病率明显高于全国平均水平。然而,由于各种 SDOH 因素,差异仍然存在。结构性和访问相关因素,特别是诊所类型和保险覆盖范围,比人口统计特征更能预测 疫苗 的完成情况,这表明结构性因素在确定 疫苗 状态方面比患者属性具有更大的影响力。这些发现强调需要采取系统级干预措施来支持系列的完成,特别是在服务不足的人群中,以支持乙型肝炎预防并减轻与癌症相关的差异。

papers.title: Trends and forecasting of reported hepatitis B and hepatitis C incidence in Hainan Province, China, 2005–2020
papers.abstract: Objective To assess long-term trends, seasonality, forecasts, and ecological associations with tourist visits for reported hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) incidence in Hainan Province from 2005 to 2020. Methods Reported HBV and HCV incidence data from Hainan, national Global Burden of Disease (GBD) estimates for China, and annual tourist visit data were analyzed. Joinpoint regression assessed temporal trends, seasonal-trend decomposition using loess evaluated monthly variation, and seasonal autoregressive integrated moving average models generated forecasts. Spearman rank correlation analysis examined tourism associations, with sensitivity analyses excluding 2020 and using first-differenced and linearly detrended series. Results Reported HBV incidence declined from 2005 to 2008, increased from 2008 to 2018, and then showed a non-significant decline through 2020; the overall average annual percent change (AAPC) was +3.37%. Reported HCV incidence increased until 2015 and subsequently declined, with an overall AAPC of +14.54%. National GBD estimates showed overall AAPCs of −0.54% for HBV and −1.52% for HCV. No significant differences among calendar months were detected. Under continuation of historical reporting patterns, the annualized projected reported HBV incidence in 2030 was 12.00 per 100,000 population (95% prediction interval: approximately 0.00–121.20), numerically close to the study-defined reference value of 12.20. The corresponding HCV estimate was 22.54 per 100,000 population (approximately 0.00–39.10), approximately 6.4 times the study-defined reference value of 3.55. The wide prediction intervals indicated substantial long-term forecast uncertainty. In 2020, observed mean monthly reported HBV and HCV incidence rates were 27.3% and 9.5% lower than forecasted values, respectively. In raw annual analyses, tourist visits correlated with reported HBV and HCV incidence (r = 0.871 and 0.879; both P < 0.001). After first differencing and linear detrending, the association remained significant only for reported HBV incidence. Conclusion Reported HBV and HCV incidence in Hainan showed distinct phased changes without significant monthly differences. The forecasts represent projections under historical reporting patterns and should not be interpreted as evidence of progress toward WHO elimination targets. Tourism associations were exploratory and ecological and do not support causal inference. Continued surveillance and strengthened HCV screening, diagnosis, and linkage to treatment remain important.

papers.title: Seroepidemiological Characteristics and Influencing Factors of Hepatitis B Virus Infection Among Pregnant Women in Nanning City, China (2024–2025): A Cross-Sectional Study
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health concern among pregnant women, with regional disparities in epidemic characteristics that hinder precise prevention of mother-to-child transmission (MTCT). This study aimed to characterize the seroepidemiological profiles of HBV infection and identify its associated influencing factors among pregnant women in Nanning City, providing evidence-based insights for optimizing targeted interventions to block HBV MTCT. A stratified cluster random sampling strategy was adopted to recruit pregnant women receiving routine antenatal care at designated medical institutions across Nanning between October 2024 and May 2025. Standardized face-to-face questionnaires were administered to collect demographic, behavioral, and disease-related data. Venous blood samples were collected for quantitative detection of five serological HBV markers via chemiluminescence immunoassay. The Kruskal–Wallis test was used to compare the geometric mean concentration (GMC) of hepatitis B surface antibody (HBsAb), while the chi-square test was applied to analyze intergroup differences in the seropositivity rates of the five HBV markers. Multivariate unconditional logistic regression models were constructed to explore factors independently associated with seropositivity of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), HBsAb, and hepatitis B core antibody (HBcAb). A total of 1,935 eligible pregnant women were enrolled. The overall seropositivity rates of HBsAg, HBsAb, hepatitis B e-antigen (HBeAg), hepatitis e-antibody (HBeAb), and HBcAb were 6.98%, 59.48%, 1.50%, 15.50%, and 33.02%, respectively. Seropositivity of HBsAg, HBsAb, HBeAb, and HBcAb exhibited an age-dependent ascending trend, with the lowest rates observed in the 14–19 age group and peak rates in the 40–49 age group. Rural residents presented significantly higher HBsAg and HBeAb seropositivity but lower HBsAb seropositivity compared with urban counterparts. Participants with unknown or no prior HBV vaccination history showed markedly higher seropositivity of HBsAg, HBeAg, HBeAb, and HBcAb, alongside reduced HBsAb positivity, relative to those vaccinated within the past 5 years or ≥5 years prior (all P < 0.001). Furthermore, individuals vaccinated ≥5 years ago demonstrated higher HBV marker seropositivity and lower HBsAb positivity than those vaccinated within 5 years (all P < 0.001). Multivariate logistic regression revealed that advanced maternal age, rural residency, comorbid chronic underlying diseases, and close contact with HBV carriers/patients were independent risk factors for HBsAg seropositivity, whereas prior HBV vaccination exerted a protective effect. Advanced age, higher educational attainment, and HBV vaccination history independently predicted higher odds of HBsAb positivity; rural residency, chronic comorbidities, and non-medical occupational status were risk factors for insufficient HBsAb seroconversion. For HBcAb seropositivity, advanced age, chronic underlying diseases, and exposure to HBV-infected individuals were independent risk factors, while higher education and vaccination history served as protective factors. The study addressed the knowledge gap regarding seroepidemiological profiles and influencing factors of HBV infection in this population to inform targeted interventions.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study recruited 1,935 pregnant women receiving routine antenatal care in Nanning City between October 2024 and May 2025 using stratified cluster random sampling across designated medical institutions.
analysis.methods: Standardized questionnaires collected demographic, behavioral, and disease-related data. Venous blood samples were analyzed for five HBV serological markers (HBsAg, HBsAb, HBeAg, HBeAb, HBcAb) via chemiluminescence immunoassay. Multivariate unconditional logistic regression models identified factors independently associated with seropositivity of HBsAg, HBsAb, and HBcAb.
analysis.main_results: The overall seropositivity rates were 6.98% for HBsAg, 59.48% for HBsAb, 1.50% for HBeAg, 15.50% for HBeAb, and 33.02% for HBcAb. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study identified advanced maternal age, rural residency, chronic comorbidities, and close contact with HBV carriers as independent risk factors for HBsAg seropositivity, while prior HBV vaccination was protective. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Findings highlight the need for targeted HBV vaccination strategies, including booster doses for childbearing-age women with insufficient HBsAb levels, to reduce incident infections and mitigate vertical transmission risk in Nanning City.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 传播 (HBV) 感染对孕妇构成持续的公共卫生挑战,区域差异使预防母婴 传播 (MTCT) 的工作变得更加复杂。该研究解决了有关该人群乙型肝炎病毒感染的血清流行病学概况和影响因素的知识差距,为有针对性的干预措施提供信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项横断面研究采用分层整群随机抽样方法,在定点医疗机构中招募了2024年10月至2025年5月期间在南宁市接受常规产前检查的1,935名孕妇。
elements_zh.methods: 标准化问卷收集人口、行为和疾病相关数据。通过化学发光免疫分析对静脉血样本进行五种 HBV 血清学标志物(HBsAg、HBsAb、HBeAg、HBeAb、HBcAb)分析。多变量无条件逻辑回归模型确定了与 HBsAg、HBsAb 和 HBcAb 血清阳性独立相关的因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 总体血清阳性率为 HBsAg 6.98%、HBsAb 59.48%、HBeAg 1.50%、HBeAb 15.50% 和 HBcAb 33.02%。HBsAg、HBsAb、HBeAb 和 HBcAb 的血清阳性率随着年龄的增长而增加,在 40-49 岁年龄组达到峰值。农村居民的HBsAg和HBeAb血清阳性率高于城市居民,但HBsAb血清阳性率低于城市居民。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究确定高龄产妇、农村居民、慢性合并症以及与 HBV 携带者的密切接触是 HBsAg 血清阳性的独立危险因素,而既往 HBV 疫苗接种 具有保护作用。新颖之处在于量化城乡差异以及 疫苗 引起的免疫力随着时间的推移而减弱。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,南宁市需要有针对性的 HBV 传播 策略,包括对 HBsAb 水平不足的育龄妇女进行加强剂量,以减少感染事件并减轻垂直 传播 风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 横截面设计限制了因果推断,并且对自我报告的 疫苗接种 历史的依赖可能会引入回忆偏差。尽管存在这些限制,但大样本量和多变量调整增强了识别风险因素的证据基础。

papers.title_zh: 中国南宁市孕妇乙型肝炎病毒感染血清流行病学特征及影响因素(2024-2025年):横断面研究
papers.source_body_en: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health concern among pregnant women, with regional disparities in epidemic characteristics that hinder precise prevention of mother-to-child transmission (MTCT). This study aimed to characterize the seroepidemiological profiles of HBV infection and identify its associated influencing factors among pregnant women in Nanning City, providing evidence-based insights for optimizing targeted interventions to block HBV MTCT. A stratified cluster random sampling strategy was adopted to recruit pregnant women receiving routine antenatal care at designated medical institutions across Nanning between October 2024 and May 2025. Standardized face-to-face questionnaires were administered to collect demographic, behavioral, and disease-related data. Venous blood samples were collected for quantitative detection of five serological HBV markers via chemiluminescence immunoassay. The Kruskal–Wallis test was used to compare the geometric mean concentration (GMC) of hepatitis B surface antibody (HBsAb), while the chi-square test was applied to analyze intergroup differences in the seropositivity rates of the five HBV markers. Multivariate unconditional logistic regression models were constructed to explore factors independently associated with seropositivity of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), HBsAb, and hepatitis B core antibody (HBcAb). A total of 1,935 eligible pregnant women were enrolled. The overall seropositivity rates of HBsAg, HBsAb, hepatitis B e-antigen (HBeAg), hepatitis e-antibody (HBeAb), and HBcAb were 6.98%, 59.48%, 1.50%, 15.50%, and 33.02%, respectively. Seropositivity of HBsAg, HBsAb, HBeAb, and HBcAb exhibited an age-dependent ascending trend, with the lowest rates observed in the 14–19 age group and peak rates in the 40–49 age group. Rural residents presented significantly higher HBsAg and HBeAb seropositivity but lower HBsAb seropositivity compared with urban counterparts. Participants with unknown or no prior HBV vaccination history showed markedly higher seropositivity of HBsAg, HBeAg, HBeAb, and HBcAb, alongside reduced HBsAb positivity, relative to those vaccinated within the past 5 years or ≥5 years prior (all P < 0.001). Furthermore, individuals vaccinated ≥5 years ago demonstrated higher HBV marker seropositivity and lower HBsAb positivity than those vaccinated within 5 years (all P < 0.001). Multivariate logistic regression revealed that advanced maternal age, rural residency, comorbid chronic underlying diseases, and close contact with HBV carriers/patients were independent risk factors for HBsAg seropositivity, whereas prior HBV vaccination exerted a protective effect. Advanced age, higher educational attainment, and HBV vaccination history independently predicted higher odds of HBsAb positivity; rural residency, chronic comorbidities, and non-medical occupational status were risk factors for insufficient HBsAb seroconversion. For HBcAb seropositivity, advanced age, chronic underlying diseases, and exposure to HBV-infected individuals were independent risk factors, while higher education and vaccination history served as protective factors. HBV prevalence among pregnant women in Nanning exceeds the national average, accompanied by prominent urban–rural disparities. Advanced maternal age and the presence of chronic comorbidities increase HBV infection vulnerability, while vaccination coverage among childbearing-age women remains suboptimal with progressive attenuation of protective antibody titers over time. We recommend targeted booster HBV vaccination for childbearing-age women with insufficient HBsAb levels to curb incident HBV infections and mitigate the risk of vertical transmission.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 传播 (HBV) 感染对孕妇构成持续的公共卫生挑战,区域差异使预防母婴 传播 (MTCT) 的工作变得更加复杂。该研究解决了有关该人群乙型肝炎病毒感染的血清流行病学概况和影响因素的知识差距,为有针对性的干预措施提供信息。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项横断面研究采用分层整群随机抽样方法,在定点医疗机构中招募了2024年10月至2025年5月期间在南宁市接受常规产前检查的1,935名孕妇。
analysis_zh.methods: 标准化问卷收集人口、行为和疾病相关数据。通过化学发光免疫分析对静脉血样本进行五种 HBV 血清学标志物(HBsAg、HBsAb、HBeAg、HBeAb、HBcAb)分析。多变量无条件逻辑回归模型确定了与 HBsAg、HBsAb 和 HBcAb 血清阳性独立相关的因素。
analysis_zh.main_results: 总体血清阳性率为 HBsAg 6.98%、HBsAb 59.48%、HBeAg 1.50%、HBeAb 15.50% 和 HBcAb 33.02%。HBsAg、HBsAb、HBeAb 和 HBcAb 的血清阳性率随着年龄的增长而增加,在 40-49 岁年龄组达到峰值。农村居民的HBsAg和HBeAb血清阳性率高于城市居民,但HBsAb血清阳性率低于城市居民。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究确定高龄产妇、农村居民、慢性合并症以及与 HBV 携带者的密切接触是 HBsAg 血清阳性的独立危险因素,而既往 HBV 疫苗接种 具有保护作用。新颖之处在于量化城乡差异以及 疫苗 引起的免疫力随着时间的推移而减弱。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,南宁市需要有针对性的 HBV 传播 策略,包括对 HBsAb 水平不足的育龄妇女进行加强剂量,以减少感染事件并减轻垂直 传播 风险。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 横截面设计限制了因果推断,并且对自我报告的 疫苗接种 历史的依赖可能会引入回忆偏差。尽管存在这些限制,但大样本量和多变量调整增强了识别风险因素的证据基础。

papers.title: Comprehensive evaluation of the αβ-TCR repertoire profile in hepatitis B vaccine-positive responders and patients with chronic hepatitis B
papers.abstract: T cells play a vital role in hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, mediating both protective immunity and immunopathology. Deep profiling of the T cell receptor (TCR) complementarity-determining region 3 (CDR3) provides critical insights into T cell composition and function. However, the characteristics of the TCR α-chain (TRA) and β-chain (TRB) repertoires in individuals with different HBV infection and vaccination statuses remain incompletely understood. We employed high-throughput sequencing (HTS) to profile the TRA and TRB CDR3 repertoires in peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from 6 inoculation-positive responders (IPR) to hepatitis B (HepB) vaccination, 6 individuals with chronic hepatitis B (CHB), and 5 healthy donors (HD). We systematically compared the frequency, diversity, similarity, and V/J segment usage of TRA and TRB CDR3s across the three groups. The CHB group exhibited significantly fewer unique TRA and TRB CDR3s than both IPR and HD groups. Overlap analysis revealed that the BUB index for TRAV was significantly higher in IPR than in CHB and HD groups ( P = 0.0073 and P = 0.0317, respectively), while for TRBV, a significantly higher BUB index was observed only between IPR and CHB groups ( P = 0.0002). Additionally, identical TRA CDR3s were preferentially shared among individuals within each group, whereas TRBJ usage remained relatively stable across groups. Collectively, our findings delineate distinct CDR3 repertoire characteristics of circulating T cells in IPR and CHB, which may enhance understanding of the protective response to HepB vaccination and inform future investigations into TRA- and TRB-based strategies for HBV diagnosis and prevention.

papers.title_zh: 乙型肝炎 疫苗 阳性反应者和 慢性乙型肝炎 患者的 αβ-TCR 谱的综合评估
papers.source_body_en: T cells play a vital role in hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, mediating both protective immunity and immunopathology. Deep profiling of the T cell receptor (TCR) complementarity-determining region 3 (CDR3) provides critical insights into T cell composition and function. However, the characteristics of the TCR α-chain (TRA) and β-chain (TRB) repertoires in individuals with different HBV infection and vaccination statuses remain incompletely understood. We employed high-throughput sequencing (HTS) to profile the TRA and TRB CDR3 repertoires in peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from 6 inoculation-positive responders (IPR) to hepatitis B (HepB) vaccination, 6 individuals with chronic hepatitis B (CHB), and 5 healthy donors (HD). We systematically compared the frequency, diversity, similarity, and V/J segment usage of TRA and TRB CDR3s across the three groups. The CHB group exhibited significantly fewer unique TRA and TRB CDR3s than both IPR and HD groups. Overlap analysis revealed that the BUB index for TRAV was significantly higher in IPR than in CHB and HD groups ( P = 0.0073 and P = 0.0317, respectively), while for TRBV, a significantly higher BUB index was observed only between IPR and CHB groups ( P = 0.0002). Additionally, identical TRA CDR3s were preferentially shared among individuals within each group, whereas TRBJ usage remained relatively stable across groups. Collectively, our findings delineate distinct CDR3 repertoire characteristics of circulating T cells in IPR and CHB, which may enhance understanding of the protective response to HepB vaccination and inform future investigations into TRA- and TRB-based strategies for HBV diagnosis and prevention.
papers.abstract_zh: T细胞在乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染中发挥关键作用,既介导保护性免疫,又参与免疫病理过程。通过深度分析T细胞受体(TCR)互补决定区3(CDR3)可为T细胞组成和功能提供重要见解。然而,不同HBV感染状态和乙型肝炎疫苗接种状态个体的TCR α链(TRA)和β链(TRB)库特征仍有待深入解析。本研究采用高通量测序(HTS)技术,对6名乙型肝炎疫苗接种阳性应答者(IPR)、6名慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者及5名健康供者(HD)的外周血单个核细胞(PBMC)中TRA和TRB CDR3库进行了表征。系统比较了三组间TRA和TRB CDR3的频率、多样性、相似性及V/J片段使用情况。CHB组的TRA和TRB CDR3的独特序列数量显著低于IPR组和HD组。重叠分析显示,IPR组TRAV的BUB指数显著高于CHB组和HD组(P=0.0073和P=0.0317),而TRBV的BUB指数仅在IPR组与CHB组间显著升高(P=0.0002)。此外,相同TRA CDR3在各组内个体间优先共享,而TRBJ使用在各组间相对稳定。综上,本研究揭示了IPR和CHB循环T细胞CDR3库的不同特征,有助于深入理解对乙型肝炎疫苗接种的保护性应答,并为未来开发基于TRA和TRB的HBV治疗和预防策略提供理论依据。

papers.title: Serological Screening for HIV, Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C, and Syphilis in Patients with Genital Molluscum Contagiosum: A Retrospective Cross-Sectional Study
papers.abstract: (1) Background: The available literature on sexually transmitted infections in patients with genital molluscum contagiosum is limited. In this study, we aimed to evaluate the serological test results and screening rate for sexually transmitted infections, including human immunodeficiency virus, hepatitis B virus, hepatitis C virus, and syphilis, among patients with genital molluscum contagiosum. (2) Methods: In this retrospective cross-sectional study, we reviewed the medical records of patients aged ≥18 years diagnosed with genital molluscum contagiosum at our dermatology outpatient clinic between October 2016 and December 2025. Age, sex, and serological test results for anti-human immunodeficiency virus, hepatitis B surface antigen, anti-hepatitis C virus, and Venereal Disease Research Laboratory/Rapid Plasma Reagin were recorded. (3) Results: Serological screening was performed in 202 of 528 patients (38.3%), and 11 (5.45%) had positive test results for at least one sexually transmitted infection. (4) Conclusions: Our findings support routine screening for sexually transmitted infections in patients with genital molluscum contagiosum, given that a substantial proportion of these patients do not undergo serological screening.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本回顾性横断面研究纳入了2016年10月至2025年12月在皮肤科门诊诊断为生殖器传染性软疣且年龄≥18岁的患者的医疗记录。记录了年龄、性别及抗人类免疫缺陷病毒、乙型肝炎病毒表面抗原、抗丙型肝炎病毒、性病研究实验室试验/快速血浆反应素的血清学检测结果。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 38.3%的患者接受了血清学筛查,5.45%的患者至少一项性传播感染检测结果为阳性。研究结果支持对生殖器传染性软疣患者进行常规性传播感染筛查,因为相当比例的此类患者未接受血清学筛查。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究未提供乙型肝炎病毒感染的患病率的详细信息,亦未说明其对生殖器传染性软疣患者的具体影响。此外,该研究未涉及针对乙型肝炎病毒的靶向干预措施的有效性或必要性。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 亟需进一步研究以明确乙型肝炎病毒感染在生殖器传染性软疣患者中的患病率及影响。此外,应探索针对该人群的乙型肝炎病毒靶向干预措施及改进筛查方案。

papers.title: siRNA daplusiran/tomligisiran and DNA vaccine JNJ-64300535 in NA-suppressed chronic hepatitis B: the OSPREY study
papers.abstract: Abstract OSPREY was a single-arm, open-label, phase 1b study that assessed whether reduction of viral antigens by the small-interfering RNA daplusiran/tomligisiran (DAP/TOM) could enhance HBV-specific T-cell and/or HBsAg responses to the DNA vaccine JNJ-64300535 (JNJ-0535) in participants with virologically suppressed, HBeAg-negative chronic hepatitis B. All participants received DAP/TOM (200 mg, Q4W) for 24 weeks and 4 doses of JNJ-0535 from Week (W)14 to W26. NA was given until W36 and continued to Follow-up W48, unless stopping criteria were met. Of 24 participants enrolled, 11 (45.8%) achieved the primary endpoint of ≥2 log 10 HBsAg reduction at W36. JNJ-0535 vaccination enhanced core/polymerase-specific T-cell responses in 22% of participants by W28, and 39% during follow-up. Seven participants stopped NA based on W36 results and had more polyfunctional CD4 T-cells targeting ≥2 HBV antigens and a greater mean reduction in HBsAg at Follow-up W48 versus those who continued NA (2.42 log 10 IU/mL vs 0.96 log 10 IU/mL).

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: OSPREY 是一项单组、开放标签、1b 期研究,涉及 24 名病毒学受到抑制、HBeAg 阴性 慢性乙型肝炎 的参与者。所有参与者均接受为期 24 周的 DAP/TOM(200 毫克,Q4W)治疗,并从第 14 周至第 26 周接受 4 剂 JNJ-0535。
elements_zh.methods: 参与者接受核苷类似物 (NA) 治疗直至第 36 周,并在第 48 周继续随访,除非满足停止标准。该研究评估了 HBsAg 减少和 T 细胞对 DNA 疫苗 JNJ-0535 的反应。
elements_zh.main_results: 在入组的 24 名参与者中,有 11 名 (45.8%) 在第 36 周达到了 ≥2 log10 HBsAg 降低的主要终点。7 名参与者根据第 36 周的结果停止了 NA,并且与继续 NA 的参与者相比,在随访第 48 周时有更多针对 ≥2 HBV 抗原的多功能 CD4 T 细胞,并且 HBsAg 平均降低幅度更大(2.42 log10 IU/mL vs 0.96 log10)国际单位/毫升)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,JNJ-0535 疫苗接种 可能会增强一些参与者的核心/聚合酶特异性 T 细胞反应,在停止 NA 的参与者和继续进行 NA 的参与者之间观察到 HBsAg 减少的显着差异。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了关于将 DAP/TOM 与 DNA 疫苗 相结合以改善 免疫应答 受抑制的 慢性乙型肝炎 患者的潜力的见解,这可以为未来的 疫苗 开发策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是一项单臂、开放标签试验,样本量较小,限制了研究结果的普遍性。由于缺乏对照组和随访的观察性质,证据是中等的。

papers.title: Predictive value of serum HBcrAg in antiviral therapy for chronic hepatitis B
papers.abstract: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a significant global public health challenge. The goals of its antiviral therapy are gradually shifting from long-term viral suppression toward achieving safer treatment discontinuation, more accurate risk stratification, and deeper functional cure. Traditional serological markers, such as HBV DNA and HBsAg, remain clinically important in CHB. However, their ability to reflect residual viral activity and long-term outcomes is limited after long-term nucleos(t)ide analog (NA) therapy, especially in patients with sustained virological suppression or marked HBsAg decline or clearance.In recent years, hepatitis B core-related antigen (HBcrAg), due to its capacity to reflect transcriptional activity of intrahepatic covalently closed circular DNA(cccDNA) and the state of the residual viral reservoir, has emerged as a notable novel biomarker in the field of CHB. Concurrently, with the development of pegylated interferon (Peg-IFN) add-on strategies and novel combination cure approaches, the potential of HBcrAg in selecting optimal patient populations and monitoring therapeutic efficacy is increasingly recognized. This review focuses on the biological basis of HBcrAg and its main predictive values in CHB antiviral therapy. It also summarizes and prospects its clinical application potential and existing challenges based on current research progress.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines the role of serum hepatitis B core-related antigen (HBcrAg) as a biomarker in antiviral therapy for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) in humans, focusing on its predictive value for treatment response, patient stratification, and monitoring of therapeutic efficacy.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review synthesizes current research on HBcrAg, emphasizing its biological basis and clinical application potential in CHB antiviral therapy, including Peg-IFN add-on strategies and novel combination cure approaches.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: HBcrAg is recognized for its capacity to reflect intrahepatic cccDNA transcriptional activity and the state of the residual viral reservoir, offering improved predictive value over traditional markers like HBV DNA and HBsAg in patients undergoing long-term nucleos(t)ide analog therapy.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights the limited ability of traditional serological markers (HBV DNA, HBsAg) to reflect residual viral activity and long-term outcomes after prolonged NA therapy, underscoring the need for further validation of HBcrAg's clinical utility.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests prioritizing research on HBcrAg's role in selecting optimal patient populations for Peg-IFN add-on strategies and novel combination therapies, as well as its integration into monitoring protocols for achieving functional cure in CHB.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the predictive value of serum HBcrAg in antiviral therapy for chronic hepatitis B (CHB), emphasizing its role in reflecting intrahepatic cccDNA activity and residual viral reservoir state. It contrasts HBcrAg with traditional markers (HBV DNA, HBsAg), which have limited utility in long-term nucleos(t)ide analog therapy. The review also explores HBcrAg's potential in guiding Peg-IFN add-on strategies and novel combination cure approaches, while acknowledging gaps in its clinical validation and the need for further research to optimize its application in CHB management.

papers.title_zh: 血清HBcrAg对抗病毒药物治疗慢性乙型肝炎的预测价值
papers.source_body_en: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a significant global public health challenge. The goals of its antiviral therapy are gradually shifting from long-term viral suppression toward achieving safer treatment discontinuation, more accurate risk stratification, and deeper functional cure. Traditional serological markers, such as HBV DNA and HBsAg, remain clinically important in CHB. However, their ability to reflect residual viral activity and long-term outcomes is limited after long-term nucleos(t)ide analog (NA) therapy, especially in patients with sustained virological suppression or marked HBsAg decline or clearance.In recent years, hepatitis B core-related antigen (HBcrAg), due to its capacity to reflect transcriptional activity of intrahepatic covalently closed circular DNA(cccDNA) and the state of the residual viral reservoir, has emerged as a notable novel biomarker in the field of CHB. Concurrently, with the development of pegylated interferon (Peg-IFN) add-on strategies and novel combination cure approaches, the potential of HBcrAg in selecting optimal patient populations and monitoring therapeutic efficacy is increasingly recognized. This review focuses on the biological basis of HBcrAg and its main predictive values in CHB antiviral therapy. It also summarizes and prospects its clinical application potential and existing challenges based on current research progress.

papers.title: Real-world effectiveness and safety of tenofovir amibufenamide in treatment-naïve chronic hepatitis B: a 48-week retrospective cohort study
papers.abstract: Objectives Tenofovir amibufenamide (TMF) is a newly recommended first-line nucleos(t)ide analogues for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) in China. However, real-world evidence on its safety and effectiveness are limited. This study aimed to evaluate the short-term virological efficacy, biochemical response, as well as safety profile of TMF over 48 weeks in a real-world cohort of CHB individuals. Methods In this single-center retrospective cohort study, 129 treatment-naïve CHB patients were administered TMF at 25 mg daily. Clinical, virological, and biochemical parameters were gathered at baseline and at weeks 12, 24, and 48 for evaluation. The primary effectiveness endpoint was virological response (VR, HBV DNA <10 IU/mL) after 48 weeks of treatment. Secondary endpoints included VR at other timepoints, alanine aminotransferase (ALT) normalization, and changes in renal parameters and lipid levels. Results At week 48, 72.9% (94/129) of patients achieved VR. Multivariate analysis identified lower baseline HBsAg levels, HBeAg negative status and non-cirrhotic status as independent predictors for achieving VR. The ALT normalization rate was 77.5% (100/129) at week 48. One patient achieved HBsAg seroclearance. Regarding safety, no adverse events linked to the medication were observed. There were no statistically significant alterations in serum phosphorus, estimated glomerular filtration rate, serum creatinine, or lipid levels (triglycerides, total cholesterol, high-density lipoprotein and low-density lipoprotein) from baseline to week 48. Conclusion In this single-arm observational cohort, TMF treatment achieved effective virological suppression and high rates of ALT normalization by week 48, with renal function and lipid levels remaining stable. Because the study lacked a comparator group, these findings should be regarded as observational. Comparative conclusions about the safety or superiority of TMF relative to tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) or tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) require dedicated head-to-head studies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study was needed to address the limited real-world evidence on the safety and effectiveness of tenofovir amibufenamide (TMF) for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) in China. The research aimed to explore its short-term virological efficacy, biochemical response, and safety profile.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A single-center retrospective cohort study was conducted involving 129 treatment-naïve CHB patients who were administered TMF at 25 mg daily. The study evaluated clinical, virological, and biochemical parameters at baseline and at weeks 12, 24, and 48.
analysis.methods: Clinical, virological, and biochemical parameters were collected at baseline and at weeks 12, 24, and 48. The primary effectiveness endpoint was defined as virological response (VR, HBV DNA <10 IU/mL) after 48 weeks of treatment, while secondary endpoints included VR at other timepoints, ALT normalization, and changes in renal parameters and lipid levels.
analysis.main_results: At week 48, 72.9% (94/129) of patients achieved virological response. The ALT normalization rate was 77.5% (100/129) at week 48. One patient achieved HBsAg seroclearance. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the use of TMF as a first-line treatment for chronic hepatitis B, particularly in real-world settings, and support its safety profile in terms of renal function and lipid levels.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the 48-week real-world effectiveness and safety of tenofovir amibufenamide (TMF) in treatment-naïve chronic hepatitis B patients. It is a single-center retrospective cohort study involving 129 patients who received TMF at 25 mg daily. The primary endpoint was virological response (VR), defined as HBV DNA <10 IU/mL, with secondary endpoints including ALT normalization and changes in renal and lipid parameters. At week 48, 72.9% of patients achieved VR, and 77.5% had ALT normalization. One patient achieved HBsAg seroclearance, and no adverse events were observed. Renal function and lipid levels remained stable throughout the study. The authors interpret these findings as demonstrating effective virological suppression and safety, but note that the lack of a comparator group limits the ability to draw comparative conclusions. The evidence is observational and thus moderate in strength.

papers.title_zh: 替诺福韦阿米布芬酰胺在 治疗 初治 慢性乙型肝炎 中的真实有效性和安全性:一项为期 48 周的回顾性 队列研究 研究
papers.source_body_en: Objectives Tenofovir amibufenamide (TMF) is a newly recommended first-line nucleos(t)ide analogues for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) in China. However, real-world evidence on its safety and effectiveness are limited. This study aimed to evaluate the short-term virological efficacy, biochemical response, as well as safety profile of TMF over 48 weeks in a real-world cohort of CHB individuals. Methods In this single-center retrospective cohort study, 129 treatment-naïve CHB patients were administered TMF at 25 mg daily. Clinical, virological, and biochemical parameters were gathered at baseline and at weeks 12, 24, and 48 for evaluation. The primary effectiveness endpoint was virological response (VR, HBV DNA <10 IU/mL) after 48 weeks of treatment. Secondary endpoints included VR at other timepoints, alanine aminotransferase (ALT) normalization, and changes in renal parameters and lipid levels. Results At week 48, 72.9% (94/129) of patients achieved VR. Multivariate analysis identified lower baseline HBsAg levels, HBeAg negative status and non-cirrhotic status as independent predictors for achieving VR. The ALT normalization rate was 77.5% (100/129) at week 48. One patient achieved HBsAg seroclearance. Regarding safety, no adverse events linked to the medication were observed. There were no statistically significant alterations in serum phosphorus, estimated glomerular filtration rate, serum creatinine, or lipid levels (triglycerides, total cholesterol, high-density lipoprotein and low-density lipoprotein) from baseline to week 48. Conclusion In this single-arm observational cohort, TMF treatment achieved effective virological suppression and high rates of ALT normalization by week 48, with renal function and lipid levels remaining stable. Because the study lacked a comparator group, these findings should be regarded as observational. Comparative conclusions about the safety or superiority of TMF relative to tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) or tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) require dedicated head-to-head studies.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的 替诺福韦阿米布芬酰胺 (TMF) 是中国新推荐的 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 一线核苷类似物。然而,关于其安全性和有效性的现实证据有限。本研究旨在评估 TMF 在现实世界 队列研究 慢性乙型肝炎个体中 48 周的短期病毒学疗效、生化反应以及安全性。方法 在这项单中心回顾性 队列研究 研究中,129 名 治疗 初治 CHB 患者每天服用 25 mg TMF。在基线以及第 12、24 和 48 周收集临床、病毒学和生化参数以进行评估。主要有效性终点是 治疗 48 周后的病毒学应答(VR、HBV DNA <10 IU/mL)。次要终点包括其他时间点的 VR、丙氨酸转氨酶 (ALT) 正常化以及肾脏参数和血脂水平的变化。结果 第 48 周时,72.9% (94/129) 的患者实现 VR。多变量分析确定较低的基线 HBsAg 水平、HBeAg 阴性状态和非肝硬化状态是实现 VR 的独立预测因素。第 48 周时 ALT 正常化率为 77.5% (100/129)。一名患者实现了 HBsAg 血清清除。关于安全性,没有观察到与药物相关的不良事件。从基线到第 48 周,血清磷、估计肾小球滤过率、血清肌酐或脂质水平(甘油三酯、总胆固醇、高密度脂蛋白和低密度脂蛋白)没有统计学上显着的变化。结论 在这项单臂观察性 队列研究 中,TMF 治疗 在第 48 周时实现了有效的病毒学抑制和高 ALT 正常化率,肾功能和脂质水平保持稳定。由于该研究缺乏比较组,因此这些发现应被视为观察性的。关于 TMF 相对于富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯 (TDF) 或替诺福韦艾拉酚胺 (TAF) 的安全性或优越性的比较结论需要专门的头对头研究。

media_mentions.content_title: Real-world effectiveness and safety of tenofovir amibufenamide in treatment-naïve chronic hepatitis B: a 48-week retrospective cohort study
media_mentions.content: Abstract Objectives: Tenofovir amibufenamide (TMF) is a newly recommended first-line nucleos(t)ide analogues for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) in China. However, real-world evidence on its safety and effectiveness are limited. This study aimed to evaluate the short-term virological efficacy, biochemical response, as well as safety profile of TMF over 48 weeks in a real-world cohort of CHB individuals. Methods: In this single-center retrospective cohort study, 129 treatment-naïve CHB patients were administered TMF at 25 mg daily. Clinical, virological, and biochemical parameters were gathered at baseline and at weeks 12, 24, and 48 for evaluation. The primary effectiveness endpoint was virological response (VR, HBV DNA <10 IU/mL) after 48 weeks of treatment. Secondary endpoints included VR at other timepoints, alanine aminotransferase (ALT) normalization, and changes in renal parameters and lipid levels. Results: At week 48, 72.9% (94/129) of patients achieved VR. Multivariate analysis identified lower baseline HBsAg levels, HBeAg negative status and non-cirrhotic status as independent predictors for achieving VR. The ALT normalization rate was 77.5% (100/129) at week 48. One patient achieved HBsAg seroclearance. Regarding safety, no adverse events linked to the medication were observed. There were no statistically significant alterations in serum phosphorus, estimated glomerular filtration rate, serum creatinine, or lipid levels (triglycerides, total cholesterol, high-density lipoprotein and low-density lipoprotein) from baseline to week 48. Conclusion: In this single-arm observational cohort, TMF treatment achieved effective virological suppression and high rates of ALT normalization by week 48, with renal function and lipid levels remaining stable. Because the study lacked a comparator group, these findings should be regarded as observational. Comparative conclusions about the safety or superiority of TMF relative to tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) or tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) require dedicated head-to-head studies. 1 Introduction Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection remains a main global health issue, significantly endangering human health and acting as a primary cause of advanced liver disease like hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and cirrhosis, which are often diagnosed at late stages (, ). According to 2022 data, the HBsAg positive prevalence in China reached 5.6%, representing nearly 80 million individuals living with HBV (). Current management strategies for CHB involves pegylated interferon (PegIFN) alongside nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs), with the primary goal of preventing the progression to liver cirrhosis and HCC (, ). Entecavir, tenofovir alafenamide (TAF), and tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) are endorsed as initial NAs options given their potent resistance profiles, which effectively suppresses the development of HBV resistance (–). Tenofovir amibufenamide (TMF) is now recommended in mainland China as a first-line NAs for CHB, providing a fourth treatment option (). Distinguished by a supplementary methyl group versus the prodrug TAF, this structural variation is thought to impart greater stability in the bloodstream and optimize the intracellular conversion process (). Studies demonstrate that TMF possesses greater stability in plasma than TDF. This property allows it to suppress HBV replication effectively with just 1/30 dose of TDF, thereby achieving a more favorable bone and renal safety profile (, ). Following its recent approval in China, comprehensive evidence from real-world settings on TMF's performance is still lacking. Therefore, this research was conducted to assess the drug's therapeutic impact and safety profile over a 48-week period in CHB patients. 2 Materials and methods 2.1 Study design and patient selection This retrospective analysis comprised 156 adults (≥18 years) with documented HBsAg positivity exceeding six months. All participants received care at Peking University People's Hospital from June 2023 through December 2024 and were consecutively enrolled. Exclusion criteria encompassed: (1) coinfection with hepatitis virus C, hepatitis virus D or human immunodeficiency virus, alcohol-related or autoimmune liver disorders, HCC, or pre-chemotherapy antiviral prophylaxis; (2) diagnosed malignancies or other severe conditions compromising survival; (3) introduction or switching of antiviral medications during the observation period; and (4) incomplete medical records. Following screening, 129 eligible participants constituted the final cohort. The institutional ethics committee at Peking University People's Hospital granted approval for the study protocol (No. 2023PHB117-001). All procedures aligned with the ethical standards established in the 1975 Declaration of Helsinki and its subsequent 1983 amendment. Given the retrospective nature of this investigation, the requirement for individual informed consent was formally waived. 2.2 Clinical data collection and definitions Patient medical information was obtained from our hospital's electronic medical records system. The collected patient characteristics comprised: age, gender, body mass index (BMI), fatty liver disease status, diabetic condition, complete blood count results [including platelet count (PLT)], liver function assessments [aspartate transaminase [AST], alanine aminotransferase [ALT], total bilirubin [TBIL], albumin], renal function evaluations [serum creatinine [Scr], estimated glomerular filtration rate [eGFR]], lipid metabolism indicators [high-density lipoprotein [HDL], low-density lipoprotein [LDL], total cholesterol [TC] and triglycerides], serum phosphorus concentrations, alpha-fetoprotein [AFP] measurements, controlled attenuation parameter [CAP] readings, and liver stiffness measurement [LSM] values. HBV virological and serological markers included HBV DNA, HBsAg and HBeAg. FIB-4 index was computed using the formula: Age (years)×AST (U/L)/PLT (×109/L)×√ALT (U/L). This scoring system serves to determine the severity of hepatic fibrosis, with values meeting or exceeding 3.25 indicating significant liver fibrosis corresponding to Metavir stage F3 or higher, while results below 1.45 effectively exclude the presence of Metavir stage F3 or greater fibrosis. Serum HBsAg and HBV DNA concentrations underwent log10 transformation prior to statistical evaluation. HBsAg seroclearance was defined as a quantitative HBsAg level below 0.05 IU/mL. Treatment response was assessed by virological suppression, characterized by HBV DNA levels falling below 10 IU/mL or becoming undetectable. Following 48 weeks of antiviral treatment, low-level viremia (LLV) was identified as either sustained or fluctuating detection of viral DNA maintained below 2,000 IU/mL, with the assay's lower limit of quantification set at 10 IU/mL. Abnormal ALT levels were determined using sex-specific thresholds: values above 30 U/L for male patients and above 19 U/L for female patients. Cirrhosis was defined by clinical, laboratory, and imaging evidence (abdominal ultrasound, CT, MRI, or transient elastography), with LSM cut-offs of 17 kPa (ALT between ULN and 5×ULN and normal bilirubin) and 12 kPa (both ALT and bilirubin within normal ranges) (); liver biopsy was used when available. All diagnoses were independently confirmed by two hepatologists via medical record review. 2.3 Treatment and follow-up Throughout the investigation period, all newly diagnosed CHB patients without prior treatment were prescribed a daily 25 mg dose of TMF following confirmation of their diagnosis. Adjunctive hepatoprotective medications were administered as clinically indicated based on physician assessment. For all enrolled subjects, clinical outcomes and relevant laboratory measures were systematically obtained over the 48-week monitoring duration. Data collection occurred at predetermined timepoints: initiation of therapy, and subsequently at weeks 12, 24, and 48. 2.4 Endpoints The primary efficacy outcome measured at week 48 was virological response (VR), characterized by plasma HBV DNA concentrations below 10 IU/mL. Secondary outcomes included VR rates during the 12-week and 24-week assessments, along with proportions demonstrating normalized ALT and quantitative HBsAg changes from initial measurements through weeks 12, 24, and 48. Safety endpoints included the change in renal function markers and lipid profiles at weeks 12, 24 and 48 in comparison with the baseline values. 2.5 Statistical analysis Continuous data were presented as mean ± standard deviation or median (interquartile range) and analyzed with Student's t-test and rank sum test. Categorical measures are reported as frequencies with percentages and evaluated using Pearson's chi-square or Fisher's exact probability tests. Logistic regression was used to identify predictors of virological suppression and ALT normalization and variables with p<0.05 in univariate logistic regression were entered into the multivariate model. The threshold for statistical significance was established at p < 0.05 for all analyses. For missing laboratory measurements at the 12-, 24-, and 48-week time points, if the missing value fell within a predefined window period (±4 weeks), we used the nearest available measurement within that window as a substitute. Values beyond this window were treated as missing and excluded from the analysis at that specific time point. The overall proportion of missing data was <5% across all time points. All computations were performed using R software (version 4.1.1). 3 Results 3.1 Baseline demographics and clinical features The final cohort comprised 129 participants who completed the full 48-week follow-up. The study population had an average age of 45.4 years, with male subjects accounting for 68.2% (n = 88). Within the cohort, 43 patients (33.3%) were HBeAg-positive, 11 (8.5%) presented with cirrhosis, and 48 (37.2%) were diagnosed with fatty liver disease. The levels of log10 HBV DNA and HBsAg (mean ± SD) and ALT [median (IQR)] in HBeAg-negative patients and HBeAg-positive patients were 3.5 ± 1.5 log10 IU/mL vs. 7.5 ± 1.7 log10IU/mL (p < 0.001), 2.9 ± 0.9 log10 IU/mL vs. 4.2 ± 0.7 log10 IU/mL (p < 0.001) and 23.0 (17.0, 37.0) U/L vs. 83.0 (39.0, 148.0) (p < 0.001), respectively. The mean creatinine and eGFR levels were 72.0 umol/L and 102.9 mL/min/1.73m2, respectively. The mean HDL, LDL, TC and triglycerides levels were 1.4 mmol/L, 2.9 mmol/L, 4.9 mmol/L and 1.2 mmol/L, respectively. The normal ALT ratios were 34.9% (45/129) in overall individuals, 50.0% (43/86) in HBeAg-negative patients and 4.6% (2/43) in HBeAg-positive patients. Table 1 summarized the baseline demographic and clinical features for the complete study population and for subgroups stratified by HBeAg status. Table 1 Baseline clinical characteristics of enrolled patients. BMI, body mass index; PLT, platelet; ALT, alanine aminotransferase; AST, aspartate aminotransferase; TBIL, total bilirubin; eGFR, estimated glomerular filtration rate; TC, total cholesterol; HDL, high-density lipoprotein; LDL, low-density lipoprotein; AFP, alpha-fetoprotein; CAP, controlled attenuation parameter; LSM, liver stiffness measurement. 3.2 Safety TMF treatment was well tolerated over the 48-week study duration, with no notable adverse reactions attributed to the medication. 3.3 Virological suppression and HBsAg decline The mean level of HBsAg at 12, 24 and 48 weeks were 3.01, 3.11 and 3.15 log10IU/mL, respectively, and showed significant difference from baseline (3.33 log10IU/mL, p < 0.001, Figure 1A). VR was attained by 94 participants (72.9%) at week 48 (Figure 1B). When categorized according to HBeAg status, VR rates demonstrated notable variation: 27.9% among HBeAg-positive individuals compared to 95.3% in HBeAg-negative patients (Figure 1C). LLV was documented in 32 cases (24.8%), constituting 65.1% (28/43) and 4.7% (4/86) of HBeAg-positive and negative subgroups, respectively. Compared with non-responders, subjects attaining VR at week 48 demonstrated older age (46.8 vs. 41.6 years, p = 0.01) and reduced frequency of both HBeAg positivity (12.8% vs. 88.6%, p < 0.001) and cirrhosis (5.3% vs. 20.0%, p = 0.017). Additionally, this group showed substantially lower mean or median baseline values across multiple parameters: HBV DNA (4.1 vs. 6.9 log10IU/mL), HBsAg (3.0 vs. 4.2 log10IU/mL), ALT (27.0 vs. 49.0 U/L), AST (26.0 vs. 46.0 U/L), eGFR (100.9 vs. 107.9 mL/min/1.73m2), and AFP (3.0 vs. 3.5 ng/mL), with all comparisons having nominal p < 0.05 (Table 2). In multivariate logistic regression analysis with variables of p< 0.05 in univariate analysis, baseline logHBsAg levels [odds ratio [OR] 0.11, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.03–0.45, p = 0.003], HBeAg positive status (OR 0.006, 95% CI 0.001–0.155, p = 0.003) and cirrhosis (OR 0.03, 95% CI 0.01–0.49, p = 0.017) were independent predictors of VR at week 48 (Table 3). During observational monitoring, a decline of HBsAg ≥0.5 log10 occurred in 19 patients (15.1%) and ≥1.0 log10 in 10 patients (7.9%). papers.title: Promiscuous Metal Site in Hepatitis B Virus X Protein Binds an Fe–S Cluster
papers.abstract: Abstract Fe–S clusters are emerging as important cofactors in viral replication but are frequently misassigned as Zn due to their O2-sensitivity and overlapping cysteine-based coordination chemistry. The Hepatitis B virus regulatory protein HBx, which is essential for viral replication and hepatocarcinogenesis, has long remained mechanistically intractable because of uncertainty surrounding its physiologically relevant metallocofactor. Although HBx can bind either an Fe–S cluster or Zn, its intrinsic disorder and extensive mutational tolerance have hindered precise characterization of its metal-binding environment. Here, we combine chemoproteomics with HYSCORE spectroscopy to define the metal-coordinating ligands in HBx and overcome limitations associated with conventional mutational analysis of disordered proteins. We exclude histidine coordination and identify C61, C69, C143, and C148 as the primary cysteine ligands for Fe–S cluster binding, with C137 functioning as a conditional auxiliary ligand. These residues also support Zn binding and overlap with regions implicated in HBx transactivation and clinically relevant variants. In addition, HBx engages the host cytosolic Fe–S cluster assembly machinery and displays sensitivity to Fe–S-targeting reagents, behavior consistent with Fe–S cluster acquisition and cofactor lability. Together, these findings propose HBx as an Fe–S cluster-associated viral protein and expand the growing class of viral Fe–S proteins that are critical for infection.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the metal-binding environment of the Hepatitis B virus regulatory protein HBx, which is essential for viral replication and hepatocarcinogenesis. The research aimed to resolve uncertainties about HBx's physiologically relevant metallocofactor, as previous studies have struggled to characterize its metal-binding properties due to its intrinsic disorder and mutational tolerance. Using chemoproteomics and HYSCORE spectroscopy, the authors identified specific cysteine residues involved in Fe–S cluster binding, excluding histidine coordination. These findings suggest HBx is an Fe–S cluster-associated viral protein, adding to the growing understanding of viral Fe–S proteins' roles in infection. The study's abstract-level evidence highlights the importance of these ligands in HBx's function and their overlap with regions implicated in transactivation and clinically relevant variants. However, the study's reliance on non-physiological methods and lack of detailed experimental validation limit the confidence in its conclusions. The results may inform future research on viral replication and hepatocarcinogenesis but do not provide direct clinical or public health implications.

papers.title: The Impact of Chronic Hepatitis D Virus Infection on Health-Related Quality of Life and Fatigue: A Real-World International Study.
papers.abstract: As little is known about the disease burden of chronic hepatitis D virus (HDV) infection, this study examined health-related quality of life (HRQoL) and fatigue at different disease stages. This was a real-world quantitative cross-sectional survey of patients in Germany, Italy, Spain and the USA. Patients were recruited via their treating physicians. Patients who had received bulevirtide for hepatitis B or treatment licensed for HDV were excluded. Of 211 patients, 41% were noncirrhotic (F0-F3); 20% had liver cirrhosis with normal function (compensated); 20% had liver cirrhosis (F4) with impaired function (decompensated); 19% had hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Mean (standard deviation; SD) age was 54.5 (11.5) years, 75% were male. ANOVA showed a significant decrease (indicating poorer HRQoL) in EQ-5D-3L visual analogue scale (VAS) scores and index values with worsening disease stage and increasing severity (all p < 0.0001). All domain scores of the Hepatitis Quality of Life Questionnaire v2 (except positive wellbeing) worsened with progressing disease and increasing symptom severity (all p ≤ 0.0001). Mean Fatigue Severity Scale (FSS) total scores also increased, indicating greater fatigue, with worsening of disease and increasing symptom severity (both p < 0.0001). HDV infection significantly impacts patients' HRQoL and fatigue, particularly for patients at later disease stages. Treatments that slow disease progression, reducing the burden of HDV infection, are needed.

papers.title: Noncanonical Roles of Hepatitis B Virus Precore RNA in Reverse
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) is a partially double-stranded DNA virus that replicates through reverse transcription. Transcription from the HBV core promoter generates two genome-length RNAs: pregenomic RNA (pgRNA) and precore RNA (pcRNA). pcRNA contains the entire pgRNA sequence plus an additional 32 nucleotides at its 5’ end that include the precore start codon, enabling translation of the precore protein, the precursor of the secreted HBV e antigen (HBeAg). Whereas pgRNA is translated to produce core and polymerase and serves as the template for reverse transcription by cis-acting HBV polymerase, pcRNA has long been considered unable to support HBV DNA synthesis. Although precore is dispensable for viral replication, it is important for chronic HBV infection. Clinically, the G1896A mutation, which introduces a premature stop codon that abolishes precore translation, is highly prevalent among HBeAg-negative patients and is strongly associated with progressive liver disease. Despite this clinical importance, the biology and functions of HBV pcRNA remain incompletely understood, in part because conventional plasmid-based systems cannot readily distinguish pgRNA and pcRNA and generate high background DNA signals that confound detailed mechanistic studies. Here, I adapted an HBV RNA-based transfection system to systematically interrogate wild-type pgRNA and pcRNA, engineered pcRNA variants that abolish precore translation, and the naturally occurring G1896A mutant pcRNA. While wild-type pcRNA supported inefficient polymerase production and minimal HBV DNA synthesis, precore-translation-defective mutants and the G1896A mutant showed efficient polymerase production and HBV DNA production. Notably, polymerase translated from pcRNA and its variants preferentially acted in trans to reverse transcribe other ε-containing RNAs, in contrast to polymerase translated from pgRNA, which functioned predominantly in cis. These findings identify pcRNA as an underappreciated source of functional HBV polymerase with trans-acting activity. I next examined the implications of this mechanism for HBV pgRNA splice variants. HBV splicing variants have garnered increasing attention due to their association with liver disease progression in chronic HBV-infected patients. The most abundant splicing variant, SP1, does not support functional polymerase expression, yet SP1-derived DNA is detected in patient sera, implying that polymerase supplied in trans may drive SP1 DNA synthesis. Using co transfection assays, I showed that pcRNA-derived polymerases, particularly those from the G1896A mutant, efficiently reverse transcribe SP1 RNA in trans, yielding increased SP1-derived DNA and providing a mechanistic explanation for the biogenesis of SP1-derived DNA. Finally, I found that the pcRNA mutant terminating precore translation within the e proximal region exhibited impaired DNA production yet enhanced trans activity, consistent with a model in which a terminating ribosome occludes the 5’ e and limits polymerase binding in cis. analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the noncanonical roles of Hepatitis B virus precore RNA in reverse transcription and its implications for viral replication and disease progression. The background highlights the importance of understanding pcRNA's function in HBV infection, particularly in relation to the G1896A mutation and its association with liver disease.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study utilized an HBV RNA-based transfection system to systematically examine wild-type pgRNA and pcRNA, as well as engineered pcRNA variants and the naturally occurring G1896A mutant pcRNA. The research was conducted using in vitro assays to assess polymerase production and DNA synthesis.
analysis.methods: The study employed co-transfection assays to compare polymerase production and DNA synthesis from pcRNA and pgRNA. pcRNA variants with targeted start and stop mutations across the precore region were analyzed to determine the effects of precore translation on reverse transcription.
analysis.main_results: Wild-type pcRNA supported inefficient polymerase production and minimal HBV DNA synthesis, whereas precore-translation-defective mutants and the G1896A mutant showed efficient polymerase production and HBV DNA production. pcRNA-derived polymerases preferentially acted in trans to reverse transcribe other ε-containing RNAs, unlike pgRNA-derived polymerases which functioned predominantly in cis.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings reveal that pcRNA is an underappreciated source of functional HBV polymerase with trans-acting activity. This challenges the previous assumption that pcRNA cannot support HBV DNA synthesis and provides a mechanistic explanation for the biogenesis of SP1-derived DNA.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results offer new insights into how precore translation affects HBV RNA packaging and reverse transcription, which could inform future studies on viral replication mechanisms and potentially lead to improved therapeutic strategies for chronic HBV infection.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro assays, which may not fully represent in vivo conditions. The evidence is strong, as it is based on systematic transfection experiments and mutation analysis, supporting a clear model of precore translation's impact on reverse transcription.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the noncanonical roles of Hepatitis B virus (HBV) precore RNA (pcRNA) in reverse transcription and its implications for viral replication and disease progression. The research highlights that pcRNA, despite being considered unable to support HBV DNA synthesis, can produce functional polymerase with trans-acting activity. This contrasts with pgRNA-derived polymerase, which functions predominantly in cis. The study also examines the impact of precore translation on the 5’ ε RNA element, showing that it disrupts polymerase binding and packaging. These findings provide a mechanistic basis for the biogenesis of HBV splicing variants like SP1 and suggest that translation-coupled remodeling of ε influences RNA selection for reverse transcription. The results have significant implications for understanding HBV replication and could inform future therapeutic strategies for chronic HBV infection.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在研究 乙型肝炎病毒 前核心 RNA 在逆转录中的非典型作用及其对病毒复制和疾病进展的影响。这一背景强调了了解 pcRNA 在 HBV 感染中的功能的重要性,特别是与 G1896A 突变 及其与肝病的关系相关的功能。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用基于 HBV RNA 的转染系统系统地检查野生型 pgRNA 和 pcRNA,以及工程化 pcRNA 变体和天然存在的 G1896A 突变 pcRNA。该研究是利用体外测定来评估聚合酶的产生和 DNA 合成的。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用共转染测定来比较 pcRNA 和 pgRNA 的聚合酶产生和 DNA 合成。分析了跨前核心区域具有靶向起始和终止 突变 的 pcRNA 变体,以确定前核心翻译对逆转录的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 野生型 pcRNA 支持低效的聚合酶生产和最低限度的 HBV DNA 合成,而前核心翻译缺陷突变体和 G1896A 突变体则显示出高效的聚合酶生产和 HBV DNA 生产。pcRNA 衍生的聚合酶优先以反式方式发挥作用,以逆转录其他含有 ε 的 RNA,这与主要以顺式方式发挥作用的 pgRNA 衍生聚合酶不同。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,pcRNA 是一种未被充分认识的具有反式作用的功能性 HBV 聚合酶来源。这挑战了之前的假设,即 pcRNA 不能支持 HBV DNA 合成,并为 SP1 衍生 DNA 的生物发生提供了机制解释。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了关于前核心翻译如何影响 HBV RNA 包装和逆转录的新见解,这可以为未来病毒复制机制的研究提供信息,并有可能改进慢性 HBV 感染的治疗策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外测定,可能无法完全代表体内条件。证据是强有力的,因为它基于系统转染实验和 突变 分析,支持前核心翻译对逆转录影响的清晰模型。

papers.abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 是一种部分双链 DNA 病毒,通过逆转录进行复制。HBV 核心启动子的转录产生两个 基因组 长度的 RNA:前基因组 RNA (pgRNA) 和前核心 RNA (pcRNA)。pcRNA 包含整个 pgRNA 序列以及 5' 端额外的 32 个核苷酸,其中包括前核心起始密码子,从而能够翻译前核心蛋白,即分泌的 HBV e 抗原 (HBeAg) 的前体。pgRNA 被翻译产生核心和聚合酶,并作为顺式作用 HBV 聚合酶逆转录的模板,而 pcRNA 长期以来被认为无法支持 HBV DNA 合成。虽然预核心对于病毒复制来说是可有可无的,但对于慢性乙型肝炎病毒感染却很重要。临床上,G1896A 突变 引入了一个提前终止密码子,废除了预核心翻译,在 HBeAg 阴性患者中非常普遍,并且与进行性肝病密切相关。尽管具有临床重要性,但 HBV pcRNA 的生物学和功能仍未完全了解,部分原因是传统的基于质粒的系统无法轻易区分 pgRNA 和 pcRNA,并产生高背景 DNA 信号,从而混淆了详细的机制研究。在这里,我采用了基于 HBV RNA 的转染系统来系统地检测野生型 pgRNA 和 pcRNA、废除前核心翻译的工程化 pcRNA 变体以及天然存在的 G1896A 突变 pcRNA。虽然野生型 pcRNA 支持低效的聚合酶生产和最低限度的 HBV DNA 合成,但前核心翻译缺陷突变体和 G1896A 突变体显示出高效的聚合酶生产和 HBV DNA 生产。值得注意的是,从 pcRNA 及其变体翻译而来的聚合酶优先以反式方式发挥作用,以反转录其他含有 ε 的 RNA,而从 pgRNA 翻译而来的聚合酶主要以顺式方式发挥作用。这些发现表明 pcRNA 是一种未被充分认识的具有反式作用的功能性 HBV 聚合酶来源。接下来我研究了这种机制对 HBV pgRNA 剪接变体的影响。HBV 剪接变异因其与慢性 HBV 感染患者肝病进展的相关性而受到越来越多的关注。最丰富的剪接变体 SP1 不支持功能性聚合酶表达,但在患者血清中检测到 SP1 衍生的 DNA,这意味着反式提供的聚合酶可能驱动 SP1 DNA 合成。通过共转染测定,我发现 pcRNA 衍生的聚合酶,特别是来自 G1896A 突变体的聚合酶,可以有效反式反转录 SP1 RNA,产生更多的 SP1 衍生 DNA,并为 SP1 衍生 DNA 的生物发生提供机制解释。最后,我发现在 e 近端区域内终止前核心翻译的 pcRNA 突变体表现出 DNA 生成受损,但反式活性增强,这与终止核糖体封闭 5’e 并限制顺式聚合酶结合的模型一致。为了进一步确定 precore 翻译如何损害 pcRNA 逆转录,我对包含 precore 区域的靶向起始和终止 突变 的 pcRNA 文库进行了系统扫描。该分析允许以氨基酸位置分辨率绘制依赖于翻译的 ε 破坏图。数据支持这样的模型:前核心 ORF 的翻译破坏了聚合酶结合、包装和逆转录起始所需的 5’ε RNA 元件。总而言之,这项工作表明 pcRNA 产生具有催化能力的 HBV 聚合酶,但持续的前核心翻译会破坏 5'e 元件并阻止 HBV 聚合酶顺式结合,从而使 pcRNA 衍生的聚合酶偏向于非经典 5'ε 含有 RNA 的反式作用逆转录。这些发现为 SP1 衍生 DNA 的生物发生提供了机制基础,并为 ε 的翻译耦合重塑如何塑造 HBV RNA 选择以进行包装和逆转录提供了新的见解。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在研究 乙型肝炎病毒 前核心 RNA 在逆转录中的非典型作用及其对病毒复制和疾病进展的影响。这一背景强调了了解 pcRNA 在 HBV 感染中的功能的重要性,特别是与 G1896A 突变 及其与肝病的关系相关的功能。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用基于 HBV RNA 的转染系统系统地检查野生型 pgRNA 和 pcRNA,以及工程化 pcRNA 变体和天然存在的 G1896A 突变 pcRNA。该研究是利用体外测定来评估聚合酶的产生和 DNA 合成的。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究采用共转染测定来比较 pcRNA 和 pgRNA 的聚合酶产生和 DNA 合成。分析了跨前核心区域具有靶向起始和终止 突变 的 pcRNA 变体,以确定前核心翻译对逆转录的影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: 野生型 pcRNA 支持低效的聚合酶生产和最低限度的 HBV DNA 合成,而前核心翻译缺陷突变体和 G1896A 突变体则显示出高效的聚合酶生产和 HBV DNA 生产。pcRNA 衍生的聚合酶优先以反式方式发挥作用,以逆转录其他含有 ε 的 RNA,这与主要以顺式方式发挥作用的 pgRNA 衍生聚合酶不同。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,pcRNA 是一种未被充分认识的具有反式作用的功能性 HBV 聚合酶来源。这挑战了之前的假设,即 pcRNA 不能支持 HBV DNA 合成,并为 SP1 衍生 DNA 的生物发生提供了机制解释。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了关于前核心翻译如何影响 HBV RNA 包装和逆转录的新见解,这可以为未来病毒复制机制的研究提供信息,并有可能改进慢性 HBV 感染的治疗策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外测定,可能无法完全代表体内条件。证据是强有力的,因为它基于系统转染实验和 突变 分析,支持前核心翻译对逆转录影响的清晰模型。

papers.abstract: HBV-related complications after hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) are generally monitored in recipients with chronic or resolved HBV infection. We describe four HSCT recipients who were HBsAg-negative, anti-HBc-negative, and HBV DNA-negative at transplantation but subsequently developed HBsAg-positive conversion with detectable HBV DNA.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate HBV-related complications in recipients who were initially HBV-seronegative but later developed HBV infection after hematopoietic stem cell transplantation. This is important because HBV-related complications are generally monitored in recipients with chronic or resolved HBV infection, but there is limited knowledge about acute infections in seronegative individuals.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study describes four cases of HSCT recipients who were HBsAg-negative, anti-HBc-negative, and HBV DNA-negative at transplantation but later developed HBsAg-positive conversion with detectable HBV DNA. The study was conducted in a clinical setting and focused on human recipients.
analysis.methods: The study involved monitoring four HSCT recipients for HBV infection status through serological testing and HBV DNA detection. The recipients were initially HBsAg-negative, anti-HBc-negative, and HBV DNA-negative, and their HBV status was assessed post-transplantation.
analysis.main_results: Four HSCT recipients who were initially HBV-seronegative developed HBsAg-positive conversion with detectable HBV DNA after transplantation. This indicates that HBV infection can occur in individuals who were seronegative at the time of transplantation.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that HBV infection can develop in initially seronegative recipients following HSCT, highlighting a potential risk that may not be widely recognized. This adds to the understanding of HBV-related complications in transplant settings.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results have implications for the surveillance and management of HBV infection in transplant recipients, particularly those who are initially seronegative. They emphasize the need for continued monitoring even in individuals without prior HBV exposure.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to four cases, which may not be representative of the broader population. However, the evidence is strong as it is based on direct observations of HBV seroconversion and DNA detection in the studied individuals.

analysis.summary_en: This study reports four cases of hematopoietic stem cell transplantation recipients who were initially HBV-seronegative but later developed HBV infection. The research highlights the risk of HBV seroconversion in individuals without prior HBV exposure, emphasizing the need for continued monitoring in transplant settings. The findings contribute to understanding HBV-related complications in HSCT recipients, particularly those who are seronegative at the time of transplantation. The study is limited by its small sample size but provides direct evidence of HBV infection development in these cases. These results have implications for surveillance and management strategies in transplant medicine, underscoring the importance of monitoring HBV status post-transplantation.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,在造血干细胞移植(HSCT)后,最初血清学阴性的受者可能发生乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染,这一潜在风险可能尚未被广泛认知。该发现有助于进一步理解移植环境中HBV相关并发症的发生机制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果对 监测 和移植受者(尤其是最初血清阴性的受者)的 HBV 感染管理具有影响。他们强调,即使是之前没有接触过乙肝病毒的个体,也需要持续监测。

papers.title: Hippuric acid contributes to NK-cell activation with dependence on TLR2 in chronic hepatitis B complicated by MASLD
papers.abstract: The coexistence of chronic hepatitis B and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (CHB-MASLD) has been linked to accelerated fibrosis progression and less favorable clinical outcomes, but the immunopathological mechanisms remain incompletely understood. In the present study, we observed that CHB-MASLD patients exhibited significantly increased peripheral natural killer (NK) cell frequency and activation, with transcriptomic analysis revealing enrichment of inflammatory effector gene signatures. Notably, TLR2 was found to be upregulated in NK cells from CHB-MASLD patients and the frequency of TLR2-expressing NK cells correlated with metabolic parameters and liver stiffness. In vitro , metabolic-stress modeling increased TLR2 expression and enhanced NK-cell cytokine production. Untargeted plasma metabolomics identified hippuric acid as a candidate metabolite enriched in CHB-MASLD, and its abundance was associated with metabolic parameters and liver stiffness. Hippuric acid was involved in promoting NK-cell activation, and this effect was partially attenuated by TLR2 blockade. Furthermore, co-culture with hippuric acid-stimulated NK cells was associated with increased activation-related readouts in LX-2 cells, which were partially attenuated by TLR2 blockade. Collectively, these findings support an immunometabolic link among metabolic dysfunction, peripheral NK-cell activation, and a partially TLR2-dependent response to hippuric acid in CHB-MASLD, offering new insights into the immunopathology of CHB-MASLD.

papers.abstract_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎 和代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪性肝病 (CHB-MASLD) 的共存与加速纤维化进展和较差的临床结果有关,但免疫病理学机制仍不完全清楚。在本研究中,我们观察到 CHB-MASLD 患者表现出外周自然杀伤 (NK) 细胞频率和激活显着增加,转录组分析显示炎症效应基因特征的富集。值得注意的是,发现 CHB-MASLD 患者的 NK 细胞中 TLR2 表达上调,并且表达 TLR2 的 NK 细胞的频率与代谢参数和肝脏硬度相关。在体外,代谢应激模型增加了 TLR2 表达并增强了 NK 细胞细胞因子的产生。非靶向血浆代谢组学将马尿酸确定为 CHB-MASLD 中富集的候选代谢物,其丰度与代谢参数和肝脏硬度相关。马尿酸参与促进 NK 细胞活化,这种作用可通过 TLR2 阻断部分减弱。此外,与马尿酸刺激的 NK 细胞共培养与 LX-2 细胞中激活相关读数的增加有关,而 TLR2 阻断部分减弱了这种读数。总的来说,这些发现支持 CHB-MASLD 中代谢功能障碍、外周 NK 细胞激活和部分依赖 TLR2 的马尿酸反应之间的免疫代谢联系,为 CHB-MASLD 的免疫病理学提供了新的见解。

papers.title: Regulatory T-cell remodeling across the HBV infection–cirrhosis continuum
papers.abstract: Regulatory T cells (Tregs) have varied functions in the course of hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection and cirrhosis. Regulatory T cells (Tregs) generally restrict excessive immune-mediated liver injury in acute HBV infection but may also inhibit antiviral immunity. During chronic infection, expanded and intrahepatically enriched Tregs suppress HBV-specific effector T-cell responses, maintain antiviral immune hyporesponsiveness and viral persistence, and limit chronic necroinflammatory injury. As the extent of HBV-related liver fibrosis progresses, there is a relative deficiency in both Tregs and Th17 cells. Treg cells are not only inhibitory to fibrosis; they are also interconnected with the immune-fibrotic microenvironment established by HSCs, and inflammation, HSC activation, extracellular matrix deposition and Treg/Th17 imbalance are all interrelated. Tregs in HBV-associated cirrhosis are highly heterogeneous, compartmentally distributed, functionally reprogrammed, and have joined an intrahepatic immunosuppressive-fibrotic network that includes myeloid cells, HSCs, natural killer cells, CD8+ T cells and Th17 cells. This paper will introduce modifications in Treg abundance, phenotype, distribution and function during the progressive alteration of these periods, as well as microenvironmental factors, Treg/Th17 dysregulation and specific therapeutic options. Therefore, the effect of regulation of Treg activity in HBV-associated liver disease is context-dependent and stage-specific, not uniform enhancement or suppression.

During chronic infection, expanded and intrahepatically enriched Tregs suppress HBV-specific effector T-cell responses, maintain antiviral immune hyporesponsiveness and viral persistence, and limit chronic necroinflammatory injury. As the extent of HBV-related liver fibrosis progresses, there is a relative deficiency in both Tregs and Th17 cells. Treg cells are not only inhibitory to fibrosis; they are also interconnected with the immune-fibrotic microenvironment established by HSCs, and inflammation, HSC activation, extracellular matrix deposition and Treg/Th17 imbalance are all interrelated. Tregs in HBV-associated cirrhosis are highly heterogeneous, compartmentally distributed, functionally reprogrammed, and have joined an intrahepatic immunosuppressive-fibrotic network that includes myeloid cells, HSCs, natural killer cells, CD8+ T cells and Th17 cells. This paper will introduce modifications in Treg abundance, phenotype, distribution and function during the progressive alteration of these periods, as well as microenvironmental factors, Treg/Th17 dysregulation and specific therapeutic options. Therefore, the effect of regulation of Treg activity in HBV-associated liver disease is context-dependent and stage-specific, not uniform enhancement or suppression.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study investigates the role of regulatory T cells (Tregs) in the progression of hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection to cirrhosis, highlighting the need to understand how Tregs contribute to immune regulation and disease outcomes.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study examines the changes in Treg abundance, phenotype, distribution and function across different stages of HBV infection and cirrhosis, focusing on the human hepatitis B virus and its associated disease states.
analysis.methods: The research analyzes Treg characteristics through immunophenotyping, functional assays, and examination of their interactions with other immune and fibrotic cells in the liver microenvironment during HBV infection and cirrhosis.
analysis.main_results: As HBV-related liver fibrosis progresses, there is a relative deficiency in both Tregs and Th17 cells, and Tregs in cirrhosis are highly heterogeneous, compartmentally distributed, and functionally reprogrammed.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that Treg activity in HBV-associated liver disease is context-dependent and stage-specific, indicating that their role varies depending on the disease phase rather than being uniformly suppressive or enhancing.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into the immune-fibrotic network in HBV-related cirrhosis, which could inform future studies on targeted therapies and the development of more precise diagnostic or monitoring tools.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on abstract-only evidence, which limits the depth of analysis, but the findings are grounded in the reported context of HBV infection and cirrhosis, supporting a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the dynamic role of regulatory T cells (Tregs) in the progression of hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection to cirrhosis. It highlights the context-dependent and stage-specific effects of Tregs, which can both restrict immune-mediated liver injury and suppress antiviral immunity. The research identifies a relative deficiency in Tregs and Th17 cells as fibrosis progresses and emphasizes the heterogeneity and functional reprogramming of Tregs in cirrhosis. These findings suggest that Tregs are intricately linked to the immune-fibrotic microenvironment, involving interactions with hepatic stellate cells, inflammation, and other immune cells. The study's implications could guide future research on immune-based therapies and diagnostic approaches for HBV-related liver disease. However, the abstract-only nature of the evidence limits the depth of analysis, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究调查了调节性 T 细胞 (Treg) 在 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染发展为肝硬化的过程中的作用,强调需要了解 Tregs 如何促进免疫调节和疾病结果。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究检查了 HBV 感染和肝硬化不同阶段 Treg 丰度、表型、分布和功能的变化,重点关注人类 乙型肝炎病毒 及其相关疾病状态。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究通过免疫表型分析、功能测定以及检查 HBV 感染和肝硬化过程中 Treg 与肝脏微环境中其他免疫细胞和纤维化细胞的相互作用来分析 Treg 特征。
elements_zh.main_results: 随着HBV相关肝纤维化的进展,Treg细胞和Th17细胞都相对缺乏,并且肝硬化中的Treg细胞具有高度异质性、区室分布和功能重编程。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,HBV 相关肝病中的 Treg 活性具有背景依赖性和阶段特异性,这表明它们的作用根据疾病阶段而变化,而不是一致抑制或增强。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了对 HBV 相关肝硬化中免疫纤维化网络的深入了解,这可以为未来的靶向治疗研究和更精确的诊断或监测工具的开发提供信息。

papers.abstract_zh: 调节性T细胞(Treg)在乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染和肝硬化过程中具有不同的功能。调节性 T 细胞 (Treg) 通常会限制急性 HBV 感染中过度的免疫介导的肝损伤,但也可能抑制 抗病毒药物 免疫。在慢性感染期间,肝内大量富集的Treg细胞会抑制HBV特异性效应T细胞反应,维持抗病毒药物免疫低反应和病毒持续存在,并限制慢性坏死性炎症损伤。随着 HBV 相关肝纤维化程度的进展,Treg 细胞和 Th17 细胞都相对缺乏。Treg细胞不仅能抑制纤维化,还能抑制纤维化。它们还与HSC建立的免疫纤维化微环境相互关联,炎症、HSC激活、细胞外基质沉积和Treg/Th17失衡都是相互关联的。HBV 相关肝硬化中的 Treg 具有高度异质性、区室分布、功能重编程,并加入了肝内免疫抑制纤维化网络,其中包括骨髓细胞、HSC、自然杀伤细胞、CD8+ T 细胞和 Th17 细胞。本文将介绍这些时期逐渐改变过程中Treg丰度、表型、分布和功能的变化,以及微环境因素、Treg/Th17失调和具体治疗方案。因此,在 HBV 相关肝病中调节 Treg 活性的效果是环境依赖性和阶段特异性的,而不是统一的增强或抑制。
